nodes.text: A week from today, the Student Council will convene, and the first article on the agenda will be...

nodes.text: Your impeachment! Hmph!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Aw man... This is the worst day of my life! I totally messed up the dance, I'm going to lose my Presidency, and everyone in the school hates me!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I don't hate you.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Angie! You're still here? You probably shouldn't be seen with me... I don't want people to be mad at you too!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Look, $Scott, you can't let Justin get to you! I `still` think you're a great President!
nodes.text_bbcode: Look, $Scott, you can't let Justin get to you! I [color=#3b78e2][i]still[/i][/color] think you're a great President!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You do?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I do! It's true, things didn't go well tonight... But you have your heart in the right place! You care about the school! More than anything else, you just want people to have a good time!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: You can be a good President, $Scott... Maybe even a great President! You just have to prove it!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Even if you're right, it's not like I have time to do anything! The whole school hates me! They're going to impeach me in a week!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: The worst part is, my parents are out of town all of this week... I was going to have people over, but instead, it's just going to be me sitting around alone in a big, empty house...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: That's it! That's how you can keep your title!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: By moping around in a big, empty house?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: No! By throwing a great party next weekend and inviting all the cliques!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Think about it! Who else is on the Student Council?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Spike, Dexter, and Taylor...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: A rebel, a nerd, and a popular girl! If I can get their cliques to like me, I bet their representatives will support me in the vote!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: All people really want is to have fun! If you throw the best party ever, I'm sure everyone will forgive you!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: The only problem is supplies... I don't know where we're going to get the stuff we need to throw a great party...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I know! My boss at the Party Superstore said that if I worked extra hard, he'd let me buy supplies off him for super cheap!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I think we can pull this off, $Scott... But you've got to promise you'll listen to me this time, okay?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I promise I will! Maybe I haven't been the best President... But I'm not giving up because some annoying VP wants the spot!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: That's the spirit! Now let's get planning... We've only got one week to throw the `best party ever!`
nodes.text_bbcode: That's the spirit! Now let's get planning... We've only got one week to throw the [color=#3b78e2][i]best party ever![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Not that bad?! Not that bad?! We've got a gym full of disgusting, dirty snow, a furious student body, and a girl with a broken leg!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: This is the worst dance the school has had since 1924, when the Winter Formal got cancelled because of a polio outbreak!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: You'll make up for it? How? How could you possible make up for this disaster?!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Well... Maybe I could organize another dance... This time, without the snow machine...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Another dance? `Another` dance? I wouldn't trust you to organize a one-man study group, much less another dance!
nodes.text_bbcode: Another dance? [color=#e23b3b][i]Another[/i][/color] dance? I wouldn't trust you to organize a one-man study group, much less another dance!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: What's the point of a one-man study group?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I'm on it!
$Scott runs backstage, where he rips a tarp off a bulky item... Revealing a massive, professional `snow machine!`
nodes.text_bbcode: $Scott runs backstage, where he rips a tarp off a bulky item... Revealing a massive, professional [b]snow machine![/b]

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Now, Angie! Open the curtains now!
$Scott slams the power button! Angie pulls the curtains aside as the machine whirrs to life, spraying the dance floor with a blanket of fake snow!
For one moment, the entire Centerscore student body freezes in stunned silence... Then...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Eeeeeek! What is this?! It's getting in my hair! It's ruining my make-up!

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: Aaaaaiiieeee! This is triggering my allergies! I can feel the hives breaking out already!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: What's going on? How are we supposed to dance now?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: This sucks!
Hector bends down, scoops up a handful of snow, and throws it at the stage! It misses and nails a tough guy in the back of the head!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Are you serious?! Not cool!
Kenji hurls a snowball back at Hector! Hector dodges to the side, slips on some snow, and flies right into his girlfriend, Amanda! The two of them go crashing down!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Amanda! Baby! Are you okay?!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Ow! My leg! I think you broke my leg!
Within seconds, the whole room has erupted into one giant, vicious snowball fight!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Well, this isn't good.
Half an hour later, the dance has been broken up, and everyone has left, furious. $Scott stands alone in the parking lot, watching the cars speed off...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I just don't get it... I thought everyone would really like the snow machine... This was supposed to be the best dance ever...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: $Scott! `$Scott!` Get over here this instant!
nodes.text_bbcode: $Scott! [color=#e23b3b][i]$Scott![/i][/color] Get over here this instant!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Aw geez, it's the Student Body VP! This dude has been giving me a hard time since I got elected!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: This was a total disaster! I don't think there's ever been such a gross mismanagement of funds in school history!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I knew you didn't have it in you to do the job! `I` was supposed to be President, but noooo... The student body wanted the guy who promised the best parties!
nodes.text_bbcode: I knew you didn't have it in you to do the job! [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] was supposed to be President, but noooo... The student body wanted the guy who promised the best parties!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Well, look what they got! An incompetent, irresponsible wreck!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Wait... Come on, Justin... Don't be hasty... I mean...
$Scott heads over to the snack table where a bunch of nerds are hanging around.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Hey, fellas! How's it going? Pretty cool dance, am I right?

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: Cool? This the worst dance ever! Where are the snacks, man? Where are the `snacks?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Cool? This the worst dance ever! Where are the snacks, man? Where are the [color=#e23b3b][i]snacks?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Uh... I guess I sort of forgot about those... But I promise I've got a `great surprise` waiting for you!
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh... I guess I sort of forgot about those... But I promise I've got a [color=#e23b3b][i]great surprise[/i][/color] waiting for you!

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: Hmm... Well, I'll give you one chance to impress me... But if this doesn't work, I'm leaving!
Nerd Approval Up!
$Scott heads over to the entrance where a bunch of popular kids are hanging out.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Hiya, ladies! How's it going? Pretty happening dance, huh?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Are you kidding? This is the lamest Winter Formal ever! Why aren't there any decorations?!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Uh... I guess I sort of forgot about those... But I promise I've got a `great surprise` waiting for you!
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh... I guess I sort of forgot about those... But I promise I've got a [color=#e23b3b][i]great surprise[/i][/color] waiting for you!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You've got one last shot to impress me, $Scott... This `better` be good!
nodes.text_bbcode: You've got one last shot to impress me, $Scott... This [color=#3b78e2][i]better[/i][/color] be good!

nodes.text: Prep Approval Up!
$Scott heads to the back of the gym where a bunch of tough-looking rebels are hanging out.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Hey, guys! How's it hanging back here? Pretty awesome dance, right?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: You've got a lot of nerve showing your face back here. This dance sucks!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Uh, okay, so I cut some corners... But I promise I've got a `great surprise` waiting for you!
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, okay, so I cut some corners... But I promise I've got a [color=#e23b3b][i]great surprise[/i][/color] waiting for you!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Well, I like the sound of that... But this better be amazing!
Rebel Approval Up!
And so, an hour later, the whole school is crowded together in the gym...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Man, this dance is going great! Everyone's having a good time, right?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Um... I'm not so sure... Take a look around.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I hate to admit it, but you might be right! I need to deal with this!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I should go talk to...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I mean, think about it! The slow music... The dim lighting... That nervous, giddy feeling in the air... It's all about romantic tension!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Why `else` would someone go to a dance?
nodes.text_bbcode: Why [color=#e23b3b][i]else[/i][/color] would someone go to a dance?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Oh, I don't know... To have fun with friends? To enjoy some good music? To get to know new people?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Yeah? And how'd you spend the last dance you went to?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I stood around trying to meet new people and enjoy good music while everyone else made out.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I rest my case. Now, come on! Let's go get my surprise ready!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: You know, you're probably right. I guess I do get hung up on the details sometimes...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Don't worry about the details, Angie. With the right people and the right mood, you could have a great party in a dirty, old basement!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I'm pretty sure they warned us about that in health class...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Okay, bad example. But you see what I'm saying, right? If people are having fun, they don't care about anything else!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Now, come on! Let's go get my suprise ready!

nodes.text: Welcome back to another year at Centerscore High!
You're just in time for the Winter Formal! You'll be playing as the Student Body President, a fun-loving guy with good intentions... But a whole lot to learn!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Oh! There you are! The dance starts in an hour, and we've got so much to set up! I still can't believe the school let us have a $500 budget!

nodes.text: First of all, I'm going to need your signature on this expense report...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Sure thing!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Great! Thanks! This is going so well!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Heh, I appreciate your help, Angie... But you really don't have to do all this! I've got this whole dance under control...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Well... Maybe I don't technically have to be here... But I'm the Student Body Secretary!

nodes.text: And what kind of a secretary would I be if I didn't help set up the Winter Formal? Now come on, let me see. What did you buy? Snacks? Lights? A fog machine?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Actually... I didn't spend the money on any of those things.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: You didn't? But that was the plan that we agreed on!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Don't worry... I spent the money on something way better! Once people see my `big surprise`, they're gonna flip out!
nodes.text_bbcode: Don't worry... I spent the money on something way better! Once people see my [color=#e23b3b][i]big surprise[/i][/color], they're gonna flip out!

nodes.text: I heard The Punkernickels were playing a show down at the skate park... You guys want to just hit that up?

nodes.speaker: Spike

The rebels tear out of the house as quickly as they came in!

nodes.text: Come on, everyone! $Scott's disappointed us... Again!
The popular crowd marches out of the house, ripping down some decorations as they go!

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: I'm not going to stay at some lame party where the host can't even bother to get good food! Nerds! To me!
All of the nerd crew rallies around Dexter.

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: We are out of here! Hmph!
The nerds angrily storm out of the house!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Did you even attempt decorating?! This place is more boring than a storage closet in a tile factory!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I guess I could've done bettter...

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: Wait a minute... Where's the food?! Did you get any food at all?!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I.... Uh... Kind of forgot...

nodes.text: Grrr...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: You're... You're just walking out? Just like that? This isn't like you, $Scott...

nodes.text: This is amazing! Everyone's here and having a good time! I didn't get impeached, `and` I totally owned Justin!
nodes.text_bbcode: This is amazing! Everyone's here and having a good time! I didn't get impeached, [color=#e23b3b][i]and[/i][/color] I totally owned Justin!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I guess I did promise people a bunch of stuff I can't deliver... But that's a problem for another day! For now, there's no way tonight could be any better!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: No way... Except...
$Scott turns and looks back in through the window.
He sees Hector with his arm around Amanda, whispering happily into her ear. He sees Brendan and Dinah happily curled up on a chair.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I wish Angie was here to see this. I wish I'd treated her better. I wish I'd done more for her. I wish... I wish...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: No. `No.` This is no time to be having thoughts like that. This is my party, and I'm going to enjoy it!

nodes.text: I do!

nodes.text: Let's do it!

nodes.text: No way! Jojo is where it's at! He's sweet and dependable and allergic to shirts!

nodes.text: Really, Hector? You think you could beat me at pool? I'm a born hustler!

nodes.text: Big talk, big talk... Let's see you put your money where your mouth is!

nodes.text: Being a good President isn't just about memorizing the student charter! It's about wanting people to have fun, about trying to help everyone have a good time!

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: R... Really? That sounds pretty good!

nodes.text: I'm not sure that's right...

nodes.text: Are you saying you know the by-laws better than I do? `Are you?`

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: ...I guess not.

nodes.text: Huh... I wonder who that is...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You! What are you doing here?!

$Scott looks behind Justin and sees all of the rebels! They look furious!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Yo, $Scott! Justin told us everything you were planning to do... Shut down the Auto-Shop and institute uniforms and make rules against skateboarding!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Those are all lies!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Please, $Scott! Who are they going to believe? Their humble Vice President, who has always been there to attend to their needs... Or a failure like you?!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Now, if you don't mind...
Justin shoves by $Scott and marches into the house, with the rebels following closely behind him!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Hey! You can't just come in here and...
Justin and the rebels barge into the den! Everyone else goes silent!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Ahem, ahem! I call to order a meeting of the Centerscore Student Council!
Soon, it is silent, save for the sound of car engines gently fading into the distance...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Fine! I don't care! I don't need them! I'm going to have a party all on my own!
And so, a little while later...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Happy birthday to me! Happy birthday to me! Happy birthday, dear $Scott...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Waaaaaaaaaah!
Even later...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I mean, what is a party, really? The Communist Party was a party, and look how that ended!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Maybe by `not` having a party, I'm doing my American duty!
nodes.text_bbcode: Maybe by [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] having a party, I'm doing my American duty!

nodes.text: And after that...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You're losing it, $Scott! You've been talking to yourself for the past three hours!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Shut up! No, I haven't!
And then...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: ...Whimper... Whimper... I guess... This is just... How it had to be...
Suddenly, $Scott's phone rings! $Scott answers it and can hear a bunch of people laughing!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Huh? What? Hello?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Oh, hey $Scott! Just calling to see how you were doing, man! Sorry, you couldn't make it to my party!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: What? Your party? You're throwing a party?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Well, I heard that the whole school was so disappointed by your sad, little failure... I just had to provide!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Duties of a `President` and all. I'm sure you understand... Or maybe you don't!
nodes.text_bbcode: Duties of a [color=#e23b3b][i]President[/i][/color] and all. I'm sure you understand... Or maybe you don't!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Quit talking and get over here, Justin! We're all jumping into the pool!

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: Mmm, this food really is delicious! This is the best party ever!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Is that $Scott on the phone? Tell him he sucks!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Well, it's been nice chatting, but I really gotta go, $Scott... My party beckons!
$Scott sits frozen in place. The phone tumbles out of his hand. He staggers out of the chair and falls to his knees.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Noooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooo!
Wow. Just wow. Alone, unloved, and on the verge of a mental breakdown!
Come on, $Scott deserves a better fate than this! Give it another shot, and try a little harder at getting the supplies that'll please your guests!
We know you can do it!
Suddenly, the door bell rings again!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: One minute... I'll get that...
$Scott heads to the front door... And finds Justin waiting for him!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Justin! What are you doing here?!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Well, I heard you were having your little party... And I just had to stop by!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I hope it's okay that I brought friends!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Aw, man, only the rebel crowd is left! One group's vote isn't going to be enough at the Student Council!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: There's nothing I can do about it now, though... So I might as well just enjoy the party!
The rebels continue to settle in and relax.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Well, it's not the whole school... But two out of three ain't bad!
The rebels and the nerds on his doorstep!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Man, I can't believe the popular crew and the nerds didn't show! One vote isn't going to be enough to sway the Student Council!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I guess there's nothing I can do about it now... So I might as well enjoy the party!
The entire rebel crew on his doorstep!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Yo, $Scott! We're here to party!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: If you think you can handle us, that is... Do you think you can handle one of `our` parties?
nodes.text_bbcode: If you think you can handle us, that is... Do you think you can handle one of [color=#3b78e2][i]our[/i][/color] parties?

nodes.speaker: Trev
nodes.text: Aw, don't scare him, Megan! We just wanna have a good time!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Well, hey, that's what I want to! Except... Are you the only ones here?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Heh, well, yeah! Who else were you expecting?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: No one, I guess...
Inside the house, the rebels settle in!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: It's cool. Who needs them? I'm going to have a party all on my own!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Happy birthday to me! Happy birthday to me! Happy birthday, dear $Scott...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Waaaaaaaaaah!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I mean, what is a party, really? The Communist Party was a party, and look how that ended!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Maybe by `not` having a party, I'm doing my American duty!
nodes.text_bbcode: Maybe by [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] having a party, I'm doing my American duty!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You're losing it, $Scott! You've been talking to yourself for the past hour!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Shut up! No, I haven't!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Whimper... Whimper... I guess... This is just... How it had to be...
Suddenly, $Scott's phone rings! $Scott answers it and can hear a bunch of people laughing!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Huh? What? Hello?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Oh hey, $Scott! Just calling to see how you were doing, man! Sorry, you couldn't make it to my party!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: What? Your party? You're throwing a party?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Oh, did I forget to invite you? Oops! It must have just slipped my mind!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Man, it's really a shame... I mean, the entire school is here!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Quit talking and get over here, Justin! We're all jumping into the pool!

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: Mmm, this food really is delicious! This is the best party ever!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Is that $Scott on the phone? Tell him he sucks!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Well, it's been nice chatting, but I really gotta go, $Scott... My party beckons!
$Scott sits frozen in place. The phone tumbles out of his hand. He staggers out of the chair and falls to his knees.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Noooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooo!
Wow. Just wow. Alone, unloved, and on the verge of a mental breakdown!
Come on, $Scott deserves a better fate than this! Give it another shot and try a little harder at getting some guests to show up.
We know you can do it!
When suddenly, the doorbell rings! $Scott runs to get it and finds...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Centerscore needs hall monitors and locker searches and security cameras! It needs stricter rules and mandatory uniforms!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: This could be a great school, $Scott... But it needs the strong hand of order! `I` could be that hand!
nodes.text_bbcode: This could be a great school, $Scott... But it needs the strong hand of order! [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] could be that hand!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Yeah, well, the students voted for me, not you, so you're just going to have to live with being the wrist!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Sorry, that sounded way cooler in my head. The point is, back off.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I will not let you lead this school down the path of decay, $Scott. I cannot just sit by and watch. I `cannot.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I will not let you lead this school down the path of decay, $Scott. I cannot just sit by and watch. I [color=#e23b3b][i]cannot.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Next Monday, you `will` be impeached... And I'm going to do whatever it takes to make sure that happens!
nodes.text_bbcode: Next Monday, you [color=#e23b3b][i]will[/i][/color] be impeached... And I'm going to do whatever it takes to make sure that happens!

nodes.text: Justin storms off.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Man, that guy is seriously messed up... I wonder what he has in mind!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: And you think what this school needs is `more parties?!` Look around you! There's vandalism on lockers! Litter on the ground! Inappropriate intimacy in the parking lot!
nodes.text_bbcode: And you think what this school needs is [color=#e23b3b][i]more parties?![/i][/color] Look around you! There's vandalism on lockers! Litter on the ground! Inappropriate intimacy in the parking lot!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: So? Who cares about those things?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I do! Because I `actually` care about this school, and I know what has to be done to improve it!
nodes.text_bbcode: I do! Because I [color=#e23b3b][i]actually[/i][/color] care about this school, and I know what has to be done to improve it!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Fun? Fun?! This school doesn't need any more `fun!` Look around you! Students are cutting class! Bullying each other! Vandalizing lockers! Kissing in public!
nodes.text_bbcode: Fun? Fun?! This school doesn't need any more [color=#e23b3b][i]fun![/i][/color] Look around you! Students are cutting class! Bullying each other! Vandalizing lockers! Kissing in public!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Well, if you're so concerned, what do you think this school needs?
Saturday morning...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Well, it's time to set everything up....

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: No sign of Angie. I guess she's really not coming.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Maybe I could've treated her better. Maybe if I'd been a better friend, I wouldn't be doing this alone...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: But I guess hindsight's twenty-twenty... And I don't have time for it right now!
School ends, and $Scott heads out to his car... Where he finds Justin waiting for him!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Hmm... You don't look all that happy to see me...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: How dumb do you think I am, $Scott? Did you really think I wouldn't figure out about your plan?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Throwing a huge party and inviting the whole school so they forget all about Winter Formal... Pretty clever. But not clever enough!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Dude, what is your problem?!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: My problem is that I'm subordinate to a lazy, unmotivated slacker like you! Why did you even run for President in the first place?!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I ran because...

options.label: I wanted to make the school better.
I wanted people to have fun.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: And the rebels can't stand you!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: The preps really don't like you...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Well, the nerds don't like you at all...
School ends that day, and $Scott is walking out when...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Whoa, I think I can hear Angie and Justin talking in that classroom... And it sounds heated!
$Scott leans in against the door and hears...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I just don't understand how you can possibly side with him over me, Angie! You of all people should be on my side!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: We're both hard-working, organized, and dedicated students! Don't we believe in the same things?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Well, yeah, I personally do like some of the things you stand for... But we're elected officials! Our job is to represent the voice of the students, not force our vision onto them!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: All I want to do is turn this school into a top-tier academic institution! If the students would rather waste school resources on partying, we have a moral obligation to `stop` them!
nodes.text_bbcode: All I want to do is turn this school into a top-tier academic institution! If the students would rather waste school resources on partying, we have a moral obligation to [color=#e23b3b][i]stop[/i][/color] them!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Spreading false rumors about $Scott's budget... Where does that fit into your 'moral obligation'?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I'll do what it takes to save this school. And besides, those rumors aren't `necessarily` false... $Scott hasn't made a budget, and the school is low on resources!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'll do what it takes to save this school. And besides, those rumors aren't [color=#e23b3b][i]necessarily[/i][/color] false... $Scott hasn't made a budget, and the school is low on resources!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I've pored over the numbers for weeks trying to find a solution, and I've found no answers... And $Scott hasn't even cracked open the books!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: He... He will! He just needs time!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: You've got so much faith in him, so much trust. Tell me, what's $Scott ever done for you? Has he ever been there when you really needed him? Even once?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: If I needed him, he'd be there for me. I'm sure of that.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: ...I think.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I don't have time to waste talking to you if you're not even going to think this through. When you're willing to listen to reason, come find me. I could use someone like you.
$Scott ducks behind a locker as Justin storms out of the classroom. Angie stays inside, sitting at a desk, deep in thought.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I'm so lucky to have Angie supporting me... I'd better not let her down!
The next day, before school starts...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Well, it's Friday... My last chance to improve my standing with the cliques or buy supplies from the store...
$Scott looks around.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Huh... No sign of Angie. I guess she's really upset...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: So I've been thinking... Even if we throw a great party, it won't matter if no one shows up!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: But how am I supposed to get people to come? Everyone's so mad at me!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: The way any good President gets support... By going out and mingling!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I bet if you just spent some time getting to know the different cliques and helping them with their problems, you'd win them over!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Huh... You're probably right!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Now, it looks like you'll have five days to get the cliques to like you.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: As far as I can tell, you'll have two times each school day to talk to individual students... Lunch and study hall.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Then there's your time after school. I know you'll be busy working at the Party Store, but if you've got some free time, I know that all three cliques hang out then.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: If you can get on their good side, I'm sure someone will tell you where to find them... And then you'll have another shot at winning them over.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Factoring in an average schedule and the time it takes to get around, I figure you'll probably be able to do two activites after school each day.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Okay... So I've got two chances during school to win people over, and two chances after school...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: But don't forget the party store!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Sounds simple to me!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Great! Then let's get to work!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I've asked my friend at the newspaper to run daily polls among the cliques to find out what people think of you... It should be a handy way to keep track of how you're doing!
Angie fumbles with her clipboard and looks at a series of papers.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Right now, the nerds don't like you, the preps don't like you, and the rebels don't like you.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Big surprise...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Well, there's the bell! I'll see you later, $Scott!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: See you around...
$Scott walks to school the next day and finds Angie waiting for him with a clipboard and an elaborate series of charts!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Hi, $Scott! Ready to get started?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Wow, you really don't miss a beat...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Nope! I've compiled some information here that should help you plan your time, if you want take a look...

options.label: Tell me all about it (View schedule tutorial).
I can figure this out on my own (Skip schedule tutorial).

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: You... You really shouldn't be here! My parents will kill me!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: If I didn't know better, I'd think you were being held hostage! Your parents will kill you if you get a C... Your parents will kill you if they see me here...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Is there anything you can do that `won't` end in your untimely demise?
nodes.text_bbcode: Is there anything you can do that [color=#e23b3b][i]won't[/i][/color] end in your untimely demise?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Shhh! Keep it down! Please!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Seriously, Angie, you need to learn how to relax! It's just one grade, and they're just your parents! Things will be okay! You don't have to be so uptight!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: How... How can you say that, $Scott? How can you be so relaxed? Things `won't` just be okay! Not unless you're organized and responsible and get all the details right!
nodes.text_bbcode: How... How can you say that, $Scott? How can you be so relaxed? Things [color=#3b78e2][i]won't[/i][/color] just be okay! Not unless you're organized and responsible and get all the details right!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: You can't just go through life like the whole thing is one big party! That's how you end up blasting people with a snow machine!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Okay, okay, I'll be the first to admit the snow machine was a bad idea... But that doesn't mean I'm living my life wrong! You can't just judge me like that!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Why not? You're so quick to tell me that I'm too uptight and high-strung!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Angie, you, uh, might want to keep it down...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I thought after what happened at the dance, you might learn or grow up or figure it out... But you're just the same old $Scott, not taking anything seriously!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: `Justin was right about you!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Justin was right about you![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Angie, you're being really...
Suddenly, Angie's door flies open and her dad runs in!

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Angie! What's going on here?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Whoa! That guy is `huge`!
nodes.text_bbcode: Whoa! That guy is [color=#e23b3b][i]huge[/i][/color]!

nodes.text: $Scott dives out the window and hides in a bush!

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Who were you talking to?!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: No one, Dad! I was just, um, thinking out loud... In an angry, passionate voice...

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: You know how your mother and I feel about unnecessary displays of emotion, young lady! Unacceptable!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Sorry, Dad...

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: And another thing...
A few minutes later, on the street outside Angie's house, $Scott crawls out from a bush and finds Angie waiting for him.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: There you are! You okay?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Yeah, sort of... Man, your dad is a pretty serious guy, huh?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I told you, $Scott. He found out about the C, and now I'm grounded for the next week!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Angie, I... I'm sorry... What I said earlier...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: No, $Scott, you don't have to apologize. I think you and I... We're just too different. This friendship, it just isn't going to work. I get that now.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Angie, wait...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Good night, $Scott. Now, please. I've got to get back before my dad catches me.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I... I understand.
Angie walks back into her house. $Scott sadly slumps down on the curb.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I still think it was the right decision to come here... But I guess it was just too little too late.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: If only I'd gotten a little bit closer to Angie before tonight... I'm sure things would've turned out differently!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Wait, what? No, $Scott, you can't come...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: $Scott?
Fifteen minutes later, at Angie's house... There's a knock on the window! Angie runs over and opens it.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: ...$Scott?
$Scott's head pops in the window.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: You don't understand my parents, $Scott! They're not permissive or understanding like yours! I'm going to be in so much trouble!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: It's just a C! People get Cs all the time, and life goes on!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You really need to lighten up and learn how to relax if you're ever going to be happy.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: That's easy for you to say! There's no pressure on you to be a perfect daughter or a perfect student!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: If I get a C, I'll be grounded for weeks! I'll be lucky if my parents let me go buy a book, much less go to a party!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: So, maybe it's time you talked back to them! You're 16 years old, not 7! Maybe you need to start fighting for your own rights!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: What do you think I've been doing with you, $Scott? You think it's `easy` for me to stand up for you?!
nodes.text_bbcode: What do you think I've been doing with you, $Scott? You think it's [color=#3b78e2][i]easy[/i][/color] for me to stand up for you?!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I could have abandoned you like everyone else! But I stood up for you and worked with you and risked it all... And you can't even give me a tiny bit of support?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Justin was right about you!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Well, you know what? Maybe this `is` my way of supporting you! I'm helping you discover that you really don't need to flip out about stuff like this!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, you know what? Maybe this [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] my way of supporting you! I'm helping you discover that you really don't need to flip out about stuff like this!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: If I'd wanted a sanctimonious lecture, $Scott, I would've just dealt with my parents. Good night.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Wait, Angie, I didn't mean...
Angie hangs up.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I was just speaking my mind... But now I feel really terrible! Maybe I should have been more supportive... Angie has done so much for me...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: But I guess it's too late for that now.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Look, I should get going. It's getting late, and my parents are going to start wondering where I am.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Have a good night, Angie.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: You too, $Scott. See you around.
That night, $Scott is sitting in his room, playing a video game when...

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: Ring, ring...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Hello?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: $Scott? Are you there?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Angie? Are you okay? What's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I... I... I just got so wrapped up in this party, and I've been spending so much time on it that I... I forgot about my class, and I... I...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I totally forgot to work on this big history project! It's due tomorrow, and there's no way I can finish it in time!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: If I turn it in late... I'll get a C! I've never gotten a C before! My parents will kill me!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Angie...

options.label: This really isn't a big deal.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I'm your `what?`
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm your [color=#3b78e2][i]what?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Uncle Chester
nodes.text: Your maid? Then why is she sitting around gabbing? Your parents are paying this girl by the hour, and she's resting on her laurels!

nodes.speaker: Uncle Chester
nodes.text: Where's your work ethic, missie?! Where's your professional pride?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Excuse me?!

nodes.speaker: Uncle Chester
nodes.text: Go on, $Scott! Tell her what to do! Make her earn that minimum wage!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Uh... Yeah! Go clean the... Uh... Floor, Missie!

nodes.speaker: Uncle Chester
nodes.text: There you go, $Scott! You tell her!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: You have got to be kidding me...

nodes.speaker: Uncle Chester
nodes.text: I don't see the floor cleaning itself, missie! Chop chop! Get to it!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Grrrrr...
Angie drops to her hands and knees and starts cleaning.

nodes.speaker: Uncle Chester
nodes.text: See, $Scott? You gotta take a strong-arm with these no-good, layabout miscreants!
Chester grabs a golf bag and heads out the door.

nodes.speaker: Uncle Chester
nodes.text: Have a good night, $Scott! Don't tell your Dad I borrowed his clubs!
Chester leaves, slamming the door shut behind him.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: What the heck was that about?! That was beyond degrading!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I am so, so sorry! I had no idea he would react like that! I think Uncle Chester has some serious issues!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Whatever. It's okay, I guess. But you're helping me clean up after the next Student Council get-together!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: That's the least I can do...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Yeah! She's my girlfriend! We're just, uh, hanging out... Discussing the future of our relationship!
$Scott wraps his arm around Angie.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Isn't that right... Sweetie?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Yes... Sweetie... That is... Very much... Correct!

nodes.speaker: Uncle Chester
nodes.text: Oh ho, I see how it is! Your folks are out of town, and you've got your little lady over for a little bit of shenanigans! Heh heh!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Uh... You sure caught me! That's `exactly` what we were up to!
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh... You sure caught me! That's [color=#e23b3b][i]exactly[/i][/color] what we were up to!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I sure do like shenanigans!

nodes.speaker: Uncle Chester
nodes.text: Don't worry, $Scott! I won't tell your Dad... If you don't tell him I borrowed his clubs!
Chester grabs a bag of golf clubs.

nodes.speaker: Uncle Chester
nodes.text: Have fun, you crazy kids!
$Scott runs over and shuts the door behind Chester.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Oh man... That was a close call! I can't believe he bought it!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Hey, I'd like to think we were pretty convincing!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Your uncle is a pretty weird guy... If we'd tried that with my family, you'd be on your way to jail!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Heh! Good thing we aren't really dating!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Right. Yeah. Good thing....

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Wow, you really know everything that's going on around here, don't you?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Well, yeah... I am School Secretary. I wouldn't be doing my job if I didn't keep track of the latest events!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I thought your job was to take notes at meetings.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Okay, so I guess maybe I take it a little too seriously... But what can I say? I really care about this school, believe it or not, and I'm sure I can make it a better place!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: That's really dorky, isn't it?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: No, not at all! You're a good person, Angie. The world needs a lot more people like you... And a lot fewer like Travis!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Hee hee!
Later that night, $Scott and Angie are busy cleaning up his house...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Hey, I can't thank you enough for helping me do this... I would've had no idea how to make things look so tidy on my own!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: No problem! Making things tidy is my specialty! You should see how organized my room is...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I can only imagine! Do you have all of your stuff perfectly alphabetized and sorted?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Alphabetized? Hee hee! Don't be silly, $Scott...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I keep everything neatly color-coded!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Why am I not surprised? Come on... Let's go give the living room one more sweep!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: It's so cool that your parents just leave the house to you like this. Mine don't even let me close the door to my room!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Oh yeah? They afraid that you're making out with some sketchy guy?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Not even! They just want to make sure that I'm studying and not goofing off! Believe me, my parents are so controlling, they'd never even let a boy in the house!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Oh ho, I got it... You're one of those girls that has to hide her boyfriends from her parents! Very, very sneaky. What's your secret make-out spot?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: It's uh... Well... I mean... Wouldn't you like to know?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Heh, I'm just teasing. The truth is, my parents probably trust me `too` much... If they knew I was planning this party, they'd flip out!
nodes.text_bbcode: Heh, I'm just teasing. The truth is, my parents probably trust me [color=#e23b3b][i]too[/i][/color] much... If they knew I was planning this party, they'd flip out!

nodes.text: Suddenly, there's the sound of a key in the front door!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Huh? Who is it? Is someone here?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I don't know! My parents aren't supposed to be back 'til Sunday!
The door swings open, and a tall man with a bushy moustache pops in!

nodes.speaker: Uncle Chester
nodes.text: Hey, $Scott! It's your Uncle Chester! I'm just swinging by to borrow some of your dad's golf clubs! Do you know where...
Chester suddenly notices Angie.

nodes.speaker: Uncle Chester
nodes.text: Oh! Sorry, missy, I didn't know $Scott was going to have company over...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I... Uh... We... He... She... They... It... Why?

nodes.speaker: Uncle Chester
nodes.text: That wasn't a coherent sentence at all! What's going on here, $Scott?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I need to think of a plausible cover... Fast!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Oh, this is Angie! She's my...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: You sure?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Trust me. I got this.

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: You two girls done with your little chat, or should I go get some stuffed animals and teacups?
$Scott walks over and gets right up in Travis' face!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Listen here, Travis! I don't like you, and you don't like me! That's fine... I'm a bad President, and you're a bad person!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Can't argue with that.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: But that doesn't mean we can't find some common ground! What if I told you I needed your help pushing people around and telling them what to do?

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: I'd say I'm interested but also confused...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I'm throwing a party this weekend, Travis. I'm going to need a big, tough, unflinching dude to be my security...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You know... Breaking up fights... Watching the door... Booting people who are out of line...

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: What's it in for me?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: The temporary illusion of power and prestige!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: That... Actually sounds pretty good!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: You've got a deal, Snowman... But don't think this makes us friends or anything!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: That is quite literally the last thing that I would ever think, ever.
$Scott and Angie walk away, and Travis resumes furiously kicking his rock.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: That was amazing! You handled that guy so well!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: What can I say? Sometimes the best way to deal with someone is to talk to them in the language they best understand... In Travis' case, brute force!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: If he does a good job, maybe we can give him something in return... I could put in a word at his Disciplinary Hearing next week...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Travis has a Disciplinary Hearing?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Yeah, he was caught beating up one of the school's potted plants. It was written up in the minutes of the last Disciplinary Council meeting.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I'm on it, $Scott! I'm a great negotiator!
Angie walks confidently over to Travis.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Ahem! Excuse me! I would like to provide a formal offer of...

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Hey! I know you! You're that dork-girl teacher's pet who's always volunteering for everything!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Get out of my face, dork-girl! I don't talk to snitches!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: What? I'm not a snitch or a dork-girl! You can't talk to me like that!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Oh yeah? Why not, dork-girl?! What're you gonna do about it? Cry? Cry some dork tears? Dork?!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Why you... You unbelievable...

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Heh, you know, you're actually really cute when you're angry... Do you want to go behind the bleachers and see where my tattoo is?

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Here's a hint: It's on my butt.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Ewwww! No! How dare you?!
Angie winds up and delivers a devastating kick to Travis' crotch!
Travis lurches back and keels over, whimpering in pain! Angie runs back to $Scott.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: What the heck was...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Not now, $Scott! Run!
Angie and $Scott run around to the front of the school.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Oh my gosh, $Scott, I don't know what just came over me! I've never hit anyone in my life! That guy was just so... So crude!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: You really should've handled him...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Probably... But hey! On the bright side, it turns out I don't need a security guy! I'll have you!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Well, I guess that's true... Besides, you probably don't want Travis at your party anyway. Did you know he got in trouble for beating up a potted plant?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: He beat up a potted plant?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Yeah, for some reason. It was written up in the minutes of the last Disciplinary Council meeting.
Later that day, after classes get out...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Hey, $Scott! Got a minute?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Uh, sure! What's up?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Well, I was wondering if we could talk a little about your party's security detail...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Security detail?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Well, sure! From what I understand, parties can get pretty rowdy... And I bet you don't want people trashing your house!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Huh... I hadn't even thought of that! But where would we find someone willing to be security?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Well, there are some students at this school who aren't necessarily averse to finding physical solutions to interpersonal conflicts...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You mean, like, people who hook up a lot?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: What? No! I meant bullies! Bullies who like to push people around!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Ooooooh.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: What do you think? I bet if we talked to one of them, he'd be happy to keep people in line!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You're probably right... And I know just the guy!
$Scott and Angie head down to the parking lot, where a burly guy is angrily kicking a rock around.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Hey, Travis! Got a sec?

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Well, well, well. If it isn't Frosty the Snowman. You know, I was actually having a pretty good time at that stupid dance 'til you pulled your little stunt!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: What do you want with me? Looking for a Presidential Beat-Down to put you out of your misery?
Angie tugs on $Scott's arm and pulls him aside.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Um, $Scott? This guy seems pretty hostile... How do you think we should do this?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Well...

nodes.prompt: How do you think we should do this?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Really? You think so? I was afraid they were too girly... But I just couldn't help myself!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: No, no, they're, um... Just right... They look, uh, really compelling... People really like... Pink...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: That's what I thought! We should start handing them out!
Angie turns around and grabs a passing student!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: No! Wait! Maybe we...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Excuse me... Would you be interested in attending a party?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: What kind of party?
Angie hands Amanda the invitation. Amanda reads it over carefully...
And her eyes light up with glee!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Eeeeee! This is the cutest invitation `ever!` I love the pink kitten! It's adorable!
nodes.text_bbcode: Eeeeee! This is the cutest invitation [color=#3b78e2][i]ever![/i][/color] I love the pink kitten! It's adorable!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Are there going to be kittens at the party? Do I have to bring my own kitten? Will there be cupcakes? I `love` cupcakes!
nodes.text_bbcode: Are there going to be kittens at the party? Do I have to bring my own kitten? Will there be cupcakes? I [color=#3b78e2][i]love[/i][/color] cupcakes!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Eeeeee! Cupcakes! Kittens! Unicorns! Eeeee!
Amanda hobbles down the hall squealing.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Is she seriously going to expect a unicorn?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You know, I think she'll be fine... Your invitations really worked!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Here, Angie. I'll take half of those, and you can take the other half... We'll hand them out together!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Thanks, $Scott! I'm glad you like them!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: They are?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: It's not like they're bad, they're just... You know... Kind of girly...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I know that! I designed them with girls in mind! Do you think guys even `look` at party invitations?
nodes.text_bbcode: I know that! I designed them with girls in mind! Do you think guys even [color=#3b78e2][i]look[/i][/color] at party invitations?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I just don't really see those appealing to the student body at large, you know?
Suddenly, a popular girl leans over $Scott's shoulder and examines the invitation!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh... My... Gosh! What a cute little invitation! I love your use of lace... And is this border embroidered?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Uh... It... Well...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Yes, it is! I embroidered it myself!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: This is fantastic design! You really should hang out with us some time... We could definitely use a talent like yours!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Thanks!
Taylor runs off, showing the invitation to several of her friends.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Huh.  Maybe I don't know people as well as I think...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: It's okay, $Scott. I understand if you don't like them... I can always make tougher, manlier ones...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: What do boys like? Bears? Guns? Bears with guns? Maybe on motorcycles?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: No, no, let's keep these invitations... They certainly seem to be working. Thanks, Angie!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Things are okay... I talked to Kenji, and he had some good advice on where to meet some rebels...
$Scott is heading to his next class when he feels a tap on his shoulder!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Hey, $Scott! Did I startle you?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Not at all! It's good to see you...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: How's the party-planning going? Have you had any luck yet today?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: It's really amazing.... 'Strapless Supernova' has this 15 percent off deal...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I love 'Strapless Supernova!'

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Oh, and there's a clearance sale at 'Not Appropriate For School'...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's, like, my favorite store! I love buying things there and then wearing them to school!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Yep, I think that's the appeal!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Come on, Sam! Let's go!
Sam and Taylor run off. $Scott glances back to where Maria was...
And finds her pressed against the school wall, furiously making out with Trev!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Mmmm, oh yeah, baby... Kiss my neck...

nodes.speaker: Trev
nodes.text: I'm on it!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Whoa!
And so, a few minutes later, after Maria has left to join her friends...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Dude, what was that? I thought you were going to just ask her out, not buy her a one-way ticket on the Make Out Express!

nodes.speaker: Trev
nodes.text: What can I say, man? I used my words!

nodes.speaker: Trev
nodes.text: Thanks for the assist today, $Scott. I really appreciate it!

nodes.text: Well, well, well.

nodes.text: All I'm saying is, we probably could've had a better code!

nodes.speaker: Scott

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: Huh? Hey, wait a minute, aren't you from...
Suddenly, Megan comes sprinting out of the Auto-Shop! Stiletto turns to face her... Just as Megan dumps a bucket of raw shrimp on her head!

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: Aaaaaaaaah! I hate `shellfish!` Aaaaaaiiiieee! Ewwwwwwww!
nodes.text_bbcode: Aaaaaaaaah! I hate [color=#3b78e2][i]shellfish![/i][/color] Aaaaaaiiiieee! Ewwwwwwww!

nodes.text: Megan dives into her car!

$Scott takes off, peeling out of the Wilson High parking lot!

$Scott hops in the car, and they take off towards the Wilson side of town!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: I'm gonna pay those Wilson punks back for what they did... But I need a good lookout, and you're the only guy around!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I don't see a catapult anywhere...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: The catapult wasn't happening. It's cool. I've come up with a `way` better idea. Check the back seat!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Ugh, what's in these buckets? They smell terrible!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Seventeen pounds of raw shrimp, that's what! Kenji 'borrowed' them from the cafeteria!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: I sent out a fake email, inviting the Wilson Auto-Shop club to a car show downtown... While they're out, we're going to pour these in all of their engines!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: It's going to be awesome!
Twenty minutes later, outside the Wilson High Auto-Shop...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Ugh, I feel gross even being here...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Look, you've just got to be my lookout. Stay in the car and watch out for trouble. Keep the engine hot in case I have to come running.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Here's the code. If you see a Wilson High student, make a noise like a cat. If you see their leader Stiletto, make a noise like a duck.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: If you see a teacher, make a noise like a cow. And if you see a security guard, make a noise like a snake. Got it? Good! Let's do this!
Megan rushes off, climbing into the Auto-Shop through the window!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Okay, okay... I've got this, I can do this... Just keep my eyes peeled for...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Oh no! That's Stiletto... And she's heading right for the Auto-Shop! What noise was I supposed to make again?

nodes.text: $Scott heads to the Auto-Shop, just as Megan peels out in her car!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: You! President guy! Get in!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Huh? Um, okay...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: You want me to back down? You want me to wuss out? I knew you were lame, but I didn't realize you were a huge pansy too!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Well, I mean... Think of it like taking the high road...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: You know who takes the high road? Pansies on unicycles! Now get out of my way! I've got to think of a really good prank...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You really don't see the problem with just keeping this conflict going? I mean, what do you think they'll do after you pull a prank on `them?`

nodes.speaker: Megan

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: See?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Yeah, I do! The nerve of those guys! They just don't know when to back down and quit! Ohhhh, I'm going to destroy them...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Hmm... I wonder how hard it would be to build a catapult...

nodes.text: This is like arguing with a brick wall...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Look, are you going to help me build this catapult or not?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: No!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Then get out of here and quit bugging me!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Fine! Talk about a waste of my time...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Now that's what I'm talking about! Heh, I didn't think you'd be so into this... You know, being School President and all...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: I didn't know you cared about the likes of us rebels.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Are you kidding? Being President means standing up for everyone at Centerscore... Especially against losers from Wilson!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Now what kind of prank were you thinking? Glue in their lockers? Stink bombs in their air vents? The good old 'chicken chase'?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: No no no, we've done all those... We've got to come up with something original...
And so, a little while later...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: And that way, when they turn on their faucets, they'll get blasted with formaldehyde!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: I love the concept, but where are we going to get a trained ferret?
And a little while after that...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Nice, nice! The whole school will have to be evacuated because of the fumes...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: And that's when we hit them with the giant water balloons!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I love it! It's the best prank ever!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Heh, thanks for helping me out, $Scott! You're actually a pretty good President...

nodes.text: Catch you later, Megan!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Sure, sure... Now I just need to figure out how to build a catapult...

nodes.text: Those punks from Wilson High have gone way too far this time! Way too far!
