nodes.text: But I only did that because they put Kenji's car up on bricks...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Which they did as revenge for Kenji changing all the locks on their Auto-Shop...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Well, it looks there's only thing you can do now.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Oh yeah? And what's that?

nodes.prompt: It looks there's only thing you can do now.

options.label: End this cycle of destruction before it consumes us all.

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: It looks there's only thing you can do now.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: They're having this amazing sale on cheese graters! It's crazy! All cheese graters must go!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And why would we `possibly` care about cheese graters?
nodes.text_bbcode: And why would we [color=#3b78e2][i]possibly[/i][/color] care about cheese graters?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Ah, come on, I know you popular girls! Always talking about how much you love grating cheese...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I hate grating cheese!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Maybe I'm thinking of something else...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Forget it, Sam. This is just another of $Scott's dumb jokes. Now let's... `Hey!` What's that skeezy guy doing talking to Maria?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Forget it, Sam. This is just another of $Scott's dumb jokes. Now let's... [color=#3b78e2][i]Hey![/i][/color] What's that skeezy guy doing talking to Maria?!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey! Loser! Get away from our friend!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Huh? No, he was just telling me that he... That he liked...
Taylor storms over and stands between Trev and Maria!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I don't know who you think you are, but it is `totally` not okay for you talk to her! Are you out of your mind?!
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't know who you think you are, but it is [color=#3b78e2][i]totally[/i][/color] not okay for you talk to her! Are you out of your mind?!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: No, really, he...

nodes.speaker: Trev
nodes.text: It's okay, Maria. This was, like, a huge mistake. I won't bug you again.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You'd better not, skate trash!

nodes.speaker: Trev
nodes.text: Come on... That's just hurtful.
Trev turns and sadly walks off. $Scott hustles after him.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Okay, okay, so my diversion didn't go exactly as planned...

nodes.speaker: Trev
nodes.text: Dude, I don't even care any more. This is going to be impossible, and I knew it. Now go away so I can sit around and think about how it all went so terribly wrong.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Sure thing, Trev. You, uh, have fun with that.
$Scott walks to the Auto-Shop, where Megan is furiously pacing around a fancy old muscle car!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Those stupid... Unbelievable... Worthless... Pieces of...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Whoa there! What's got you so riled up?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: What's got me riled up? That's got me riled up! Look at the side of my '68 Fjord Anaconda! What does that look like to you?!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Hey, Trev! What's got you so worked up?

nodes.speaker: Trev
nodes.text: I'm doing it, man! I can't deal with these feelings any longer! I'm going over there, and I'm asking Maria out!
$Scott glances over and sees Maria chatting with her friends Taylor and Sam.

nodes.speaker: Trev
nodes.text: Check it out. I'm going to walk by and slip this love letter into Maria's purse! It has a box she can check to indicate if she likes me or not!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Okay... Sounds good. But wait, if Maria has the note in her possession, how will you learn how she feels about you?

nodes.speaker: Trev
nodes.text: Well, I was also going to slip her this self-addressed, stamped envelope. Pretty ingenious, huh?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Trev, what if... And I'm just spitballing here... But what if you went up to Maria, and you told her how you feel about her?

nodes.speaker: Trev
nodes.text: You mean, like, with words...? That I, like, say out loud...?

nodes.speaker: Trev
nodes.text: Yeah! Okay! That might totally work if I could get Maria alone...

nodes.speaker: Trev
nodes.text: But that's impossible! You know how popular girls are. Sam and Taylor never leave Maria's side.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Trev, you just figure out what you want to say to Maria. Leave the distraction to me!
$Scott jogs over to the popular girls.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Hey, uh, Taylor! Sam! Come here! It's really important!
Taylor and Sam walk over.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What is it? What do you want?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I, uh, just wanted to tell you about these great sales going on at the mall!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh, really? What's on sale?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Okay, $Scott... Think fast and keep them distracted!
$Scott strolls to the parking lot, where Trev is anxiously pacing around.

nodes.speaker: Trev
nodes.text: But I'm a rebel, and Maria's popular. We're like oil and vinegar, cats and dogs, one Fighting Fish and another Fighting Fish!

nodes.speaker: Trev
nodes.text: What would she ever see in a guy like me?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Well, think about it like this... What do you see in her?

nodes.speaker: Trev
nodes.text: I guess, like, that she's pretty... And smart... And she always looks so good... And she seems, uh, I dunno, like a good person...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: So, do you think you'd like her just as much if she was always covered in oil stains and worked on cars and swore like a sailor?

nodes.speaker: Trev
nodes.text: What? No! Then she'd be just like a girl version of Kenji! And just thinking about that makes me feel all icky inside!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Actually, what I was going for was, would you still like her if she was a rebel?

nodes.speaker: Trev
nodes.text: Huh... Probably not...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: See? You like her `because` she's different... And she probably feels the same way about you!
nodes.text_bbcode: See? You like her [color=#e23b3b][i]because[/i][/color] she's different... And she probably feels the same way about you!

nodes.speaker: Trev
nodes.text: Whoa, man... That is... Deep... You're like the smartest dude ever!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I'm telling you, Trev, you've totally got a shot with this girl! You just gotta believe in yourself!

nodes.speaker: Trev
nodes.text: I don't care what my friends say about you. You're all right in my book!
Rebel Approval Up!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Thanks, Trev! I'll see you around!

nodes.speaker: Trev
nodes.text: You're probably right, man. I gotta totally turn myself around! I'm gonna have to become a jock!
Trev throws off his jacket, straightens himself up, and clears his throat.

nodes.speaker: Trev
nodes.text: Yo, uh, hey there, $Scott. You, uh, wanna talk about some football? I really like it when those dudes tackle those other dudes... Good ol' tackling...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: That's, uh, that's... Hmm.

nodes.speaker: Trev
nodes.text: I sure hope there's a party this weekend, bro! I wanna arm-wrestle and make stupid jokes and be all dumb and stuff...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Now you're just coming off as bitter...

nodes.speaker: Trev
nodes.text: Hey, is that a rebel? We should go beat him up and break his skateboard! I bet that'd be a good idea, huh, bro? Wanna do that bro? Bro? `BRO?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, is that a rebel? We should go beat him up and break his skateboard! I bet that'd be a good idea, huh, bro? Wanna do that bro? Bro? [color=#e23b3b][i]BRO?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Stop, stop! You're kind of scaring me, man!

nodes.speaker: Trev
nodes.text: Sorry, $Scott... I guess I got kinda carried away...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Carried away? That was super-weird!

nodes.speaker: Trev
nodes.text: You wouldn't understand, man. You're the Class President. It's your job to get along with everybody. You don't know what it's like to be a rebel!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Trev, I...

nodes.speaker: Trev
nodes.text: Just leave me alone, okay? All you've done is make me feel worse!
$Scott heads to the parking lot, where Trev is practicing tricks on his skateboard.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Hey, Trev. Wow! That was a pretty sweet nollie kickflip you just landed.

nodes.speaker: Trev
nodes.text: Thanks, buddy, I...

nodes.speaker: Trev
nodes.text: Whoa! Not you, dude! I'm, like, not supposed to talk to you...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Guess your friends weren't very thrilled with what happened at the Winter Formal...

nodes.speaker: Trev
nodes.text: You can say that again! If I'd known you were going to deliver whiteout conditions, I would've brought my snowboarding jacket.

nodes.speaker: Trev
nodes.text: As it was, I got mad soaked, and `this` got ruined.
nodes.text_bbcode: As it was, I got mad soaked, and [color=#e23b3b][i]this[/i][/color] got ruined.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: But that's just a soggy piece of paper.

nodes.speaker: Trev
nodes.text: That's what it is now, but it used to be a love letter. I was going to give it to this girl I've got a serious crush on. But now... You know, like, forget it.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Wait! Trev, you still like this girl, right?

nodes.speaker: Trev
nodes.text: Dude, I don't just `like` her. I'm crazy about her!
nodes.text_bbcode: Dude, I don't just [color=#e23b3b][i]like[/i][/color] her. I'm crazy about her!

nodes.speaker: Trev
nodes.text: I can't sleep. I can't concentrate. Even scarfin' down slices of pizza doesn't satisfy anymore.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Then we have to do something about it!

nodes.speaker: Trev
nodes.text: Did you say 'we'?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You were all set to ask this girl out, and I ruined your chances. The way I see it, I owe you one. Now which girl is it?

nodes.speaker: Trev
nodes.text: Well... Her! Maria!
$Scott looks over where Trev is pointing... And sees a group of popular girls laughing!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Hee hee! You really think `she's` good enough for the squad? I'm voting for Sam!
nodes.text_bbcode: Hee hee! You really think [color=#3b78e2][i]she's[/i][/color] good enough for the squad? I'm voting for Sam!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Her? You're into `her?` But she's a cheerleader, and you're, well, a guy who hangs out in the parking lot!
nodes.text_bbcode: Her? You're into [color=#e23b3b][i]her?[/i][/color] But she's a cheerleader, and you're, well, a guy who hangs out in the parking lot!

nodes.speaker: Trev
nodes.text: I know, man, but I can't help it! I dig this girl something awful! What do you think I should do?

nodes.prompt: What do you think I should do?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What do you think I should do?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: The truth is it isn't really up to just me. If you want me and my friends to show up to your party, you're going to have to get on the good side of Trev and Megan.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Yeah?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Definitely. If they go, everyone else will, too. Megan works on her car during lunch, and Trev hangs out in the parking lot during study hall.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: And if you really want to impress the crew, swing by the skate park after school. That's where we all hang out.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Wow. Thanks, Kenji. You've been really helpful.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: See ya.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Car horns? What's to know about car horns?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: A whole lot, actually. Did you know that most car horns sound the note F sharp?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Yeah, and before air horns were invented there was a law that said that self-propelled vehicles had to be preceded by a man on foot waving a red flag.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: That's hilarious! I guess you really do know something about cars.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Only what I picked up from my uncle. He loves cars, and he's a history buff, too. I bet you and he would have a lot to talk about.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Heh! You're a pretty okay guy, $Scott.
Rebel Approval Up!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: So, can I expect to see you and your friends at my party?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Bold move, $Scott. Engines are my specialty.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Yeah... well... I bet you didn't know that when the Fjord Anaconda was introduced, it had a P6 engine with 260 karmic cinch displacement.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Uh... I think you mean 'V6'. It means that the cylinders are mounted in a 'V' shape. As for the other stuff, I'm not even sure those were real words.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Oh, huh... Are you sure? I thought it was called a P6 because it was six times more powerful than... Uh... 6... Ponies?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: You don't know anything about cars, do you?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Beyond the whole 'they get you to and from school' thing? Honestly, not much. But I really do want you and your friends to come to my party. I promise it'll be better!
$Scott heads down to the Auto-Shop, where he spies Kenji tuning the engine of a classic car.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Hey there.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Well well, if it isn't President Punching Bag.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: I guess you aren't so happy about what happened at the Winter Formal.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: I wouldn't say that. You did play terrible music and ruin the dancing...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: But did you see the look on the faces of those preps and nerds when the thermostat got dialed to Antarctic? Priceless.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: It was?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Sure. I haven't seen that much panic since the Great Chemistry Lab Fire of 2008.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Right. Well, I came by because I'm throwing a party this weekend, and you and your friends are invited.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: I don't know about that. A lot of my friends were wearing leather when you turned on that snow machine. The smell... The shrinking... Really not cool.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: I don't think they're the type to forgive and forget...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Before you say 'no', I should mention that there will be plenty of parking. It'd be a great chance to show off these awesome muscle cars you've been working on.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: You know about cars?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Well, yeah... I mean, a little bit.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Okay then, smart guy, tell me something I don't already know.

nodes.prompt: Tell me something I don't already know.

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Tell me something I don't already know.

nodes.text: $Scott creeps slowly and carefully over, pressing himself just under the frat house window. The shades are drawn, but he can hear voices...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Uh oh! That sounds like a girl's voice!

nodes.speaker: Female Voice
nodes.text: Oh yeah... You like the way I look? Am I hot enough for you?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Oh geez, this sounds really wrong...

nodes.speaker: PERSON_MALe Voice
nodes.text: Nice, nice... I'm liking what I'm seeing... You're scoring big points, big points...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Wrong `and` creepy... Oh man...
nodes.text_bbcode: Wrong [color=#e23b3b][i]and[/i][/color] creepy... Oh man...

nodes.speaker: PERSON_MALe Voice
nodes.text: Now jump up and down and sing 'Baa Baa Back Sheep!'

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Wait, what?

nodes.speaker: Female Voice
nodes.text: Baa baa black sheep, have you any wool? Yes sir, yes sir, three bag's full!

nodes.speaker: PERSON_MALe Voice
nodes.text: That's it! Congratulations!
The shades fly open! $Scott looks in and sees a bunch of guys wearing fluffy, pink skirts and a tall, scrawny guy dressed as Li'l Bo Beep!

nodes.speaker: Frat Guy
nodes.text: You have passed the final test, Will! Welcome to M.A.N.!

nodes.speaker: Will
nodes.text: Phew! Talking like a girl was really straining my voice! Now can I change out of this outfit?

nodes.speaker: Frat Guy
nodes.text: No, keep it on... You'll need it for the pudding-wrestling party later tonight!
$Scott staggers back over to Jessica with a shell-shocked look on his face!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Well? What's going on? Did you find out what he's up to?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: The good news is he's not cheating on you... He's just doing his pledge challenges to get into M.A.N.!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: That makes so much sense! I'm so relieved! But what's the bad news?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: That I'm going to need years of therapy before I can even think about going to college! Let's get out of here!
$Scott drops Jessica off back at the football field.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Thanks, $Scott! I really appreciate your help!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: No problem!
$Scott slowly creeps over to the frat house window... Leans over to get a look inside...
And slips, smacking onto the ground!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Ow! My butt!

nodes.speaker: PERSON_MALe Voice
nodes.text: Huh? What was that?!
The frat house door flies open, and a bunch of frat guys run out wearing fluffy pink skirts!

nodes.speaker: Frat Guy
nodes.text: Look! There's a spy! This loser was trying to see our Secret Initiation Ritual!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: That's what you guys are doing?

nodes.speaker: Frat Guy
nodes.text: Who sent you? Was it those losers at D.U.D.? The girls at O.M.G.? `Who?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Who sent you? Was it those losers at D.U.D.? The girls at O.M.G.? [color=#e23b3b][i]Who?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I wasn't sent by any of those letter combinations! This girl Jessica thought her boyfriend Will was cheating on her, and I was just checking it out!
A scrawny guy dressed as Li'l Bo Beep steps forward.

nodes.speaker: Will
nodes.text: Jessica thinks I'm cheating on her? She... She doesn't trust me? Is she here right now?!
Will looks up and spots Jessica on the quad! He jogs angrily towards her!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Will! What are you wearing? It's adorable!

nodes.speaker: Will
nodes.text: So you don't trust me, huh? You think I'm cheating on you? You send this loser to spy on me?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Man, why is everyone always calling me a loser...?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It was $Scott's idea, I swear! He's the one that said we should come here! I never would've done it on my own! He made me do it!

nodes.speaker: Will
nodes.text: Yeah, whatever, girl. I've got no place in my life for sneaks and spies. I'm out of here.
Will storms off, and Jessica goes running after him!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Wait, Jessica! Don't you need a ride back?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Die in a fire!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Guess I messed that one up...
$Scott looks around and notices a girl hiding behind the bleachers, crying!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Jessica? Is that you?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh, it... It's you. I d... D... Didn't see you coming...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Are you okay? What's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It's my stu... Stupid no-good boyfriend, Will! He's a f... Freshman at Centerscore University... And I'm sure he's cheating on me!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: What makes you so confident?
Jessica wipes her eyes.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: He's been acting all weird lately, not telling me where he's going or what he's doing... And today he's not returning my calls!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Well, you said he's at Centerscore U, right? Do you know where to find him?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah, he's pledging for this fraternity, M.A.N... He should be near there!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Then let's swing by and take a look! After all, you'll feel better knowing what he's up to!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You...You'd do that for me?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Sure! What are Class Presidents for?
Fifteen minutes later, at Centerscore University, Jessica and $Scott stand on the campus quad...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Okay, the M.A.N. house is just over there... Will's window is the one on the far left side!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You stay here... I'll sneak up to it and check it out...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Okay, $Scott... Time to be a ninja. Let's take this nice and sneaky...
$Scott heads down to the football field where the cheerleaders are practicing.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Huh, I don't see Jessica... I wonder where she is...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh Em Gee. I `love` the mall, and I totally need a new outfit! You, like, read my mind!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh Em Gee. I [color=#3b78e2][i]love[/i][/color] the mall, and I totally need a new outfit! You, like, read my mind!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You'd be shocked at how easy it was...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Come on! Let's get out of here while the other girls are distracted!
Ten minutes later, at the Centerscore mall...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Okay, we've only got, like, half an hour. You know how to speed-shop, right?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I'm a quick-learner.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Follow my lead, then. You'll do just fine!
Half an hour later, $Scott staggers out of the mall, nearly buried under the huge pile of shopping bags he's carrying...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: How you doing there, boy-toy? You got a handle on it?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I never knew... There were so many shoes. Why... Why would there ever be... This many shoes...?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ah, it's fine, you big baby! We didn't even hit half the stores! Just be glad we were `speed` shopping!
nodes.text_bbcode: Ah, it's fine, you big baby! We didn't even hit half the stores! Just be glad we were [color=#3b78e2][i]speed[/i][/color] shopping!

nodes.text: $Scott loads Jessica's bags into his car.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Thanks for hanging out with me today, $Scott! You're like the doting but totally non-threatening male friend I've always wanted to have!
Prep Approval Up!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You know what? I'll take that as a compliment!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Are you serious? Are. You. Serious? I `heart` the beach!
nodes.text_bbcode: Are you serious? Are. You. Serious? I [color=#3b78e2][i]heart[/i][/color] the beach!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Heh, me too!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Lying in the sun... Soaking up the rays... Checking out cute guys...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Yeah! Wait, what was the last one?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Let's go!
Ten minutes later, down at the Centerscore beach...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: This is `sooooo` nice! Check out that guy down by the water, the one with the surfboard... You could eat ice cream off those abs...
nodes.text_bbcode: This is [color=#3b78e2][i]sooooo[/i][/color] nice! Check out that guy down by the water, the one with the surfboard... You could eat ice cream off those abs...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: This is making me really uncomfortable...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh, relax... I didn't mean `you` specifically! Now shhh! Look at this guy over here, with the tattoos and the huge muscles and the angry expression...
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, relax... I didn't mean [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] specifically! Now shhh! Look at this guy over here, with the tattoos and the huge muscles and the angry expression...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: He's, uh, coming right at us...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Uh oh. I think I might've made out with this guy once... Or maybe twice...

nodes.speaker: Kent
nodes.text: Yo, Jessica! What's going on? Who's this loser?!

nodes.speaker: Kent
nodes.text: Is this some kind of messed up mind-game or something?! You dodge my calls, you never come by, and now you show up at my beach with some high school dork?!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Quick, $Scott! Stand up for me!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Uh, listen here, buddy! You can't talk to Jessica like that! Now back off, or I'll take you out, and I don't mean to dinner!

nodes.speaker: Kent
nodes.text: ...Seriously?
Ten minutes later, $Scott drives Jessica back to Centerscore, rubbing sadly at his bruised cheek...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ugh, that was terrible!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I know! That guy can throw one mean punch! He must really work out...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: No, not him, you! You call that sticking up for me?! My little brother could do better, and he's, like, eight!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Hey! I'm not even your boyfriend! I shouldn't have to protect you from your crazy convict axe-murderer exes!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ugh, whatever. Just drop me off at school, okay?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: My pleasure!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: That's got to be her!
$Scott strolls over to Jessica and hunkers down next to her.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Well, how about that? Mr. School President himself, blocking my sun. Is there something I can help you with?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: No, not exactly. How's it going around here?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It's terrible! I am `soooooo` bored! These stupid tryouts just won't end!
nodes.text_bbcode: It's terrible! I am [color=#3b78e2][i]soooooo[/i][/color] bored! These stupid tryouts just won't end!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: But you're, uh, not trying out...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Well, yeah, I'm already on the team! The tryouts are for some new girl to take Amanda's spot... You know, since she broke her leg at the Winter Formal...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: ...Right.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Hey, do you have a car?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Yeah...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: We should cut and do something fun! I am so down to get out of here!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'd drive myself, but my license got suspended a week ago... It turns out it's illegal to drive while having a dance party! Totes ridic, right?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Uh... Yeah... Those words.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So, you wanna cut?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Sure, why not?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yay! You're the best, Mr. President Guy! Where do you wanna go?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Let's go hit up...
$Scott heads down to the football field, where the cheerleaders are practicing.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Let's see... Hector said she'd be the one tanning...
$Scott looks around and sees a girl lying out on the bleachers in a bikini, sipping on a fruity drink!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Wait, Zach!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: What's up, bro? You want another chest bump?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: No, absolutely not! I'm just not sure this is the best idea... You know, you trying to get Amanda back and everything!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: You don't think she'd take me?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Well, no, it's not that, it's just... Well... Think of it this way. Would you go into playoffs without having practiced at all?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Oh, I see what you're getting at! You're saying I should ask her out after football practice when I'm all good and sweaty!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: What? No! Eww! I'm saying maybe you need to practice your game before asking out Amanda! You know, like, try asking `another` girl out first!
nodes.text_bbcode: What? No! Eww! I'm saying maybe you need to practice your game before asking out Amanda! You know, like, try asking [color=#e23b3b][i]another[/i][/color] girl out first!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Bro, you are, like, the smartest person who ever lived! A practice game! I love it! Whoo!
Zach runs down the field and flirts with a cheerleader, a cute freshman girl. The two chat for a while. Zach flexes his muscles several times.
A few minutes later, he comes sprinting back with a huge grin!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: I did it! I got her number! We're going on a date this Friday! Yes! Zach is the best!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Way to go, man! And Amanda?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Pffft, who cares about her? She can marry DJ Dorkus for all I care! I've got a hot date! Ungh! Who's number one? Zach's number one!
Zach runs off, pausing only to kick over a trashcan and knock the books out of a nerd's hands.
Prep Approval Up!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I can't even begin to understand what goes on in that guy's head... But who am I to judge someone that happy?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Wish me luck, bro!
Zach runs off. $Scott watches from afar as he sprints up to Amanda... The two of them talk quietly... They lean in... And then...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Eww, no, Zach! I will `not` make out with you! I'm dating Hector now!
nodes.text_bbcode: Eww, no, Zach! I will [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] make out with you! I'm dating Hector now!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: But you made out with Hector when you were dating me! Doesn't that mean you have to make out with me now?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: For the last time, that's not how making out works! I looked it up in the encyclopedia!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Making out is in the encyclopedia?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Just leave me alone, okay? Hector makes me feel special, special in a way no other guy ever did. I am `not` going to break up with him, even if he's a jerk sometimes!
nodes.text_bbcode: Just leave me alone, okay? Hector makes me feel special, special in a way no other guy ever did. I am [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] going to break up with him, even if he's a jerk sometimes!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Fine! You don't know what you're missing, you dumb bimbo! Look at these biceps! Look at these glutes! Any other girl would love to hook up with this! I'm the Zack Attack!
Zach storms off the field!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Now, look, the thing is, I wanted to warn you but...
Zach punches $Scott in the gut and storms off!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: `Zach Attack!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Zach Attack![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Oh man... I really should've done something to stop him...

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: I took a guitar lesson, and it was amazing! It was like... I was taking my emotions... And making music out of them! Just like a wizard!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: $Scott! Just the guy I was hoping to see! I took your advice, bro!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You... Did?
$Scott wanders over to the weight room, where Zach is intensely pacing around.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: What are you talking about? I've got tons of personality! Have you even seen me on the football field? I'm all about personality!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: I got taunts! I got insults! I got amazing touchdown dances!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: That's not really what I meant...

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Heh, heh, like sometimes, I do this thing where I wave my hands and cluck like a chicken... See, I'm suggesting that the other team are chickens!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I got that. I meant more like...

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Bawk! Bawk! It's the Zach Attack! You just got hit by the Zack Attack! Bawk! Bawk!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: `Zach!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Zach![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: ...Bawk?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I don't mean personality on the football field! I mean personality in real life! You know, like, are you sensitive? Are you compassionate? Are you caring?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Ohh... I think I'm starting to get what you're talking about!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Next time I get a touchdown, I should start going on about how much I miss Amanda!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: No, that's not what I meant, and also it's kind of weird and pathetic...

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: I'll fall on my knees... Shout her name out... Promise to be the man of her dreams... And then I'll do the chicken dance!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Look, maybe this personality thing is the wrong way to go about this. I'm starting to think it might not be your strongest suit...

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Yeah, whatever, man. You're just scared of the Zack Attack! If you can't handle the heat, get out of the weight room!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Yeah, okay, fine. See you later, I guess.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: What? But I'm totally popular! I'm a quarterback, dude! I don't know if you realize, but that's a pretty big deal!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Yeah, maybe in, like, 1985! But it's different now! Quarterbacks are so `not` the coolest thing anymore!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, maybe in, like, 1985! But it's different now! Quarterbacks are so [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] the coolest thing anymore!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: They... Aren't?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Look, there are two things high school girls are into these days. Vampires that sparkle when the sun hits them, and guys that make music!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Hector is a vampire?! I knew it!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: No, dude, Hector is a musician! He's a DJ, and he's really good at it! And that makes him more popular than you!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: You... You're right! I need to get cooler, cooler than Hector! And that means learning how to play a musical instrument! I bet I'd look pretty sweet playing the guitar!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Exactly! Maybe you just need a boost to your image, man! A quarterback that plays guitar? Now `that's` the coolest guy in school! That guy could get any girl!
nodes.text_bbcode: Exactly! Maybe you just need a boost to your image, man! A quarterback that plays guitar? Now [color=#e23b3b][i]that's[/i][/color] the coolest guy in school! That guy could get any girl!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Thanks, man! You're a pretty good School President after all!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Oh, before you go... Are you `sure` Hector isn't a vampire? Because I could go get a stake...
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, before you go... Are you [color=#e23b3b][i]sure[/i][/color] Hector isn't a vampire? Because I could go get a stake...

nodes.text: Prep Approval Up!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: 99 percent certain. See you later, Zach!
$Scott wanders over to the weight room, where Zach is furiously bench-pressing.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Twenty-three... Twenty-four... Twenty-five! Arrrrrrrghhhh!
Zach slams the weight down and stands up.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Hey there, Zach! Good to see that you're, uh, really putting some emotion into it...

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: For your information, I'm pretending that the weight is Hector, and I'm lifting him!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Is this some weird football thing?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: And then, after I've lifted him, I throw him into a raging volcano!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Oh, I get it. It's some sort of personal thing. What's your beef with Hector?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: That stupid loser stole my girlfriend, Amanda! She and I were perfect for each other! We were like peas in a pea-holder!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: That sucks, man... But maybe it's time you moved on! I'm planning on throwing a huge party this weekend, you know, and...

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: What's the point? How am I supposed to move on when I don't even know what I did wrong in the first place?!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Why would she leave me for a loser like Hector? What does he have that I don't? He's not buff, he's not fit, he's not in shape at all! I'm way better looking!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: He's not even a football player! What could she see in him?!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Well, it's not really my place to say, but maybe it's not about that, you know? There's more to attraction than looks!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Huh? Like what?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Um... Like...

nodes.prompt: There's more to attraction than looks, like...

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: There's more to attraction than looks, like...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: So will you and your friends come to the party?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, maybe I'll go if nothing else comes up, I guess. But I don't speak for the whole popular crew.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: If you want them to show up, you're going to have to impress a lot more people than just me. I'd start with Zach and Jessica... They both could use some help right now.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Zach's a big jock who hangs out around the weight room during lunch. He and I... Well, we don't exactly get along.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Jessica's a cheerleader, and she likes to hang out around the football field during study hall. She'll be the one lying out and tanning.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Any other leads?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Well, if you really want to impress my friends, you could always swing by the Volunteering Club after school.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: The popular kids like volunteering?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Well, a couple of us do... But mostly we just use it as a place to gossip and get extracurricular credit!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Heh! Thanks, Hector! You know, you're a really helpful guy!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah, just don't go telling the whole school it was me, okay? I've got a reputation to protect!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Sure thing!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You... You want me to teach you?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Yeah, of course! You're the best, right? Your parties are literally legendary! My little brother asked me about them, and he's only in first grade!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: He wanted to know if it's true that you had a bunch of supermodels riding around on dinosaurs!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Heh, I think I know what he's thinking of... Except they weren't supermodels, they were cheerleaders... And they weren't dinosaurs, they were... Eh, never mind.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Well, Hector? Will you help me be as awesome as you?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Man, I know you're just stroking my ego... But what can I say? My ego loves a good stroking! You really wanna know how to throw a good party?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I'm all ears.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Okay, there's four basic types of party: The Dance, The Dinner, The Hangout, and The Parliamentary Subcomittee...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Go on...
One informative lunch period later...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Man, that's amazing advice! So I play three fast songs, then a slow one?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Trust me. That's the perfect rhythm to get girls in the mood to hook up. It's been proven by science.
Prep Approval Up!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Thanks so much, Hector... You're like the guru of partying!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Oh really? You want me to DJ?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Well, sure! You're the best in the school!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Do you know what the best part of being a DJ is, $Scott? It's watching the hot girls dance.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Now, I've got a really hot girlfriend. And I love to watch her dance. But you know why she won't be dancing any time soon?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: It's because she broke her leg during the snowball fight at your stupid Winter Formal! No, I won't be your DJ!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Okay, dude, I'm sorry! I messed up! Geez!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I just want everyone at the school to have a good time... That's all I ever wanted... I just... I can't help it if I'm not as cool as you...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Aw man, don't do that! Don't do the 'sad puppy who just needs Hector's help' thing! That just makes me feel pity!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Is it working?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, kinda! Now I'm just going to feel lousy if your party fails! Way to ruin it for me!
$Scott walks over to where Hector is listening to some music, and pulls up a seat at his table.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Whoa, whoa, whoa. What do you think you're doing? I'm officially mad at you!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Because of your stupid snow-machine stunt, my girlfriend broke her leg... And she's mad at `me!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Because of your stupid snow-machine stunt, my girlfriend broke her leg... And she's mad at [color=#e23b3b][i]me![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Look, I'm sorry about what happened, but I've got the perfect way for you to make it up for her! I'm throwing a party this weekend, and both of you are invited!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You and all your friends should come! It'll be the best party ever!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Okay, first of all, I already threw the best party ever. Last year, remember? The whole school came, I was an awesome DJ, and you jumped into the pool wearing a lampshade!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Heh. That was awesome.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And second, dogg, why would we possibly want to go to `your` party? So you can blast us all with sand and break Amanda's other leg?
nodes.text_bbcode: And second, dogg, why would we possibly want to go to [color=#e23b3b][i]your[/i][/color] party? So you can blast us all with sand and break Amanda's other leg?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Because I'm not allowed to push wheelchairs... Not since the jousting incident at the nursing home...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Look, Hector, I'm begging you here, man. I need your help.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Oh yeah? With what?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I want you to...

options.label: Teach me how to throw a party!
Be the DJ at my party.

nodes.text: $Scott and Brendan search frantically through the props, tossing them all around!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Fake limbs... A wooden cow... A big pile of moustaches...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: A cool-looking chalice... A 1940s mobster suit... And... Hey! One shiny, antique locket!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Huh? That's it! You found it!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Thank you so much, $Scott! I can't thank you enough!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Hey, man, it's all good. I'm just helping out a friend in need! Now, let's just clean this up before...
Suddenly, someone knocks on the prop room door!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Brendan? Are you in there?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Play it cool, dude! You can't let her know you ever lost it!
$Scott dives behind a plywood set right as Dinah comes in!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh! Dinah! I... I was just... You see, I was... The funny thing is...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Happy birthday!
Brendan holds out the locket.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Oh, Brendan! It's beautiful! I absolutely love it!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You do?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: It's the best! You know me so well!
Dinah leans forward and gives Brendan a passionate kiss! As the two of them leave, Brendan shoots $Scott a big thumbs-up!
Nerd Approval Up!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Heh... Well, it looks like I've got at least one person supporting me!
$Scott and Wesley work diligently to assemble the costume...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Let's see... We'll put the metal plates together here...

nodes.speaker: Wesley
nodes.text: Put in some pillows for extra padding...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Spray-paint the whole thing gold... and viola! One Robo-Don costume!

nodes.speaker: Wesley
nodes.text: This looks fantastic! Thanks, $Scott!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Don't thank me yet, buddy... Let's see if you've got the voice to pull it off!

nodes.speaker: Wesley
nodes.text: Ahem ahem...

nodes.speaker: Wesley
nodes.text: You come to me... On the day of my daughter's processor re-alignment... And you ask me to decommission another robot?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Awesome! That's dead-on! You're definitely going to win this thing!

nodes.speaker: Wesley
nodes.text: Do not worry. I will make those judges an offer their processing units will be unable to refuse.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Yes!

nodes.speaker: Wesley
nodes.text: Take care, $Scott. I suppose I... I appreciate your assistance.
Nerd Approval Up!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: No problem, Robo-Don. No problem at all.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You're definitely going to win! I mean, that costume is top-notch!

nodes.speaker: Boris
nodes.text: You... You think so?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I mean, yeah! Your bolts are shiny, your design is flawless, and... Is that real metal plating?

nodes.speaker: Boris
nodes.text: Of course! I'm the Don! I settle for nothing but the very best!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Everyone here is talking about you! I mean, I was just talking to that girl over there, and she was going on and on about how good you looked...

nodes.speaker: Boris
nodes.text: Wait, what? Which girl?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: The one over there, dressed as CatLady...

nodes.speaker: Boris
nodes.text: The one in the skin-tight leather?!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Yeah! She was going on and on about how cute she always thought Robo-Don was... How much she liked his slow, raspy wheezing...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: She told me she'd ask you out but figured she wasn't good enough for you...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: She also mentioned how much she likes dirty pick-up lines!

nodes.speaker: Boris
nodes.text: I... I... I... I'll be right back!
Boris stumbles over to the girl dressed as CatLady. Thirty-five seconds later, she screams and slaps him.
Three bulky security officers drag him away.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Too far? Maybe. But he's from Wilson, and it's my responsibility as President to make sure we beat them at every turn!
A few minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Wesley
nodes.text: I did it! I won! I'm the Year's Best Robot!

nodes.speaker: Wesley
nodes.text: I don't know what you did to Boris, but you have my eternal gratitude!

nodes.speaker: CatLady
nodes.text: Excuse me... Number One Robot? I just wanted to say, I looooove your costume...
Nerd Approval Up!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: And that's my cue to get out of here. Good luck, Wesley!

nodes.speaker: Wesley
nodes.text: See you around, $Scott!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You'll drop out if you know what's good for you!

nodes.speaker: Boris
nodes.text: You... You're threatening me?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You better believe it!

nodes.speaker: Boris
nodes.text: You threaten me? You come to me... On the day of my daughter's processor re-alignment? And you threaten me?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: What? No, no, I'm not acting out the scene from the movie, I'm...

nodes.speaker: Boris
nodes.text: What have I ever done... To make you treat me so disrespectfully? Why did you not come to me as a brother in components, as a companion in synaptic nodes?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: No, moron, I'm threatening you `for real!` Like, with violence! In real life!
nodes.text_bbcode: No, moron, I'm threatening you [color=#e23b3b][i]for real![/i][/color] Like, with violence! In real life!

nodes.speaker: Boris
nodes.text: You talk about violence. Is violence going to bring back your central processing unit to you? Or my visual processing circuit to me?

nodes.speaker: Boris
nodes.text: No. No, it is not. Now get out of my way!
Boris shoves by $Scott and marches to the front of the room.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Well, that didn't work.
A few minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Wesley
nodes.text: That was an absolute disaster! Boris won the award, and I looked like a buffoon! You told me you'd do something about it!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: My plan didn't work, okay? That guy was unbluffable!

nodes.speaker: Wesley
nodes.text: Of course he was unbluffable! He was Robo-Don! He leaves unhooked computer monitors in the beds of his enemies!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You guys really aren't that good at separating fantasy from reality, are you?

nodes.speaker: Wesley
nodes.text: Not following.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: ...Never mind.
$Scott drives down to the arcade... And finds it totally packed!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Whoa... This must be that CenterCon thing...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: And those are some skimpy costumes! Wow!

nodes.speaker: Wesley
nodes.text: $Scott! What are you doing here?!
Wesley staggers up to $Scott, his robotic costume clanking loudly!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I'm just checking out the sights, Robo-Don... How are you doing?

nodes.speaker: Wesley
nodes.text: Terrible! Just terrible!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: What's wrong? Your costume looks fine...

nodes.speaker: Wesley
nodes.text: Yeah, it's fine... But gaze upon that!
$Scott looks over and sees a burly guy in a vastly better Robo-Don costume!

nodes.speaker: Wesley
nodes.text: That's Boris, some weird nerd from our rival school, Wilson High! Look at him! There's no way my costume can compete!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: He's got the rusty exhaust pipe and everything...

nodes.speaker: Wesley
nodes.text: They're holding the Best Robot event in five minutes! What do I do?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You just go up there and do your clanky, wheezy best, okay? I'll handle this other guy!
Wesley runs up towards the front of the room where the contest is being held, while $Scott rushes back to cut off the other guy...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Hey! You! Robo-Don!

nodes.speaker: Boris
nodes.text: Eh? What do you want, eh? I'm just an old robot, looking out for his family...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Right. Listen, there's something I need to tell you about this costume contest...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: How do I play this?
$Scott and Wesley work diligently to assemble the costume...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Let's see... We put the metal plate here... And we connect these tubes here...

nodes.speaker: Wesley
nodes.text: Are you sure this is right? It looks pretty funny to me...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I'm telling you, dude, this is correct! Now put it on!
Wesley puts the costume on...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Hrm.

nodes.speaker: Wesley
nodes.text: Hrm? Hrm? What does 'hrm' mean? Get me to a mirror at once!
Wesley staggers over to a mirror...

nodes.speaker: Wesley
nodes.text: What the... This is awful! These parts are all wrong! I look like Robo-Don from Robo-Don 2... After he gets blown up by a car bomb!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Well, um, maybe that could be your costume instead? Blown-up Robo-Don?

nodes.speaker: Wesley
nodes.text: That was my costume last year! And it failed horribly! Ladies don't want to make out with a gentleman who looks like he's been hit with a car bomb!

nodes.speaker: Wesley
nodes.text: Get out of here! I need time to fix your mess!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Sorry, man... I just wanted to help...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Hey, is there a guy in here named Wesley? I'm looking for Wesley...
A tall, pale nerd emerges from the corner.

nodes.speaker: Wesley
nodes.text: I am the one who is called Wesley. Who disturbs my solitude?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Um. Wow. Okay. It's, uh, me. I'm disturbing your solitude.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Does it really count as solitude if you're at the arcade? I mean, there's a ton of people here...

nodes.speaker: Wesley
nodes.text: Well... I'm being solitary!

nodes.speaker: Wesley
nodes.text: Besides, I have no time to debate semantics with your like! I have a costume that needs my immediate attention!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: A costume? But Halloween isn't for, like, a year!

nodes.speaker: Wesley
nodes.text: It's not for Halloween, you buffoon! It's for CenterCon... The giant annual Centerscore science fiction convention!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Oh, I've heard about that... Don't girls wear, like, really skimpy outfits?

nodes.speaker: Wesley
nodes.text: Oh yeah. It's awesome!

nodes.speaker: Wesley
nodes.text: But it won't matter if I don't win the Costume Contest! If I lose, no girl will even give me the time of day!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Well, what are you going dressed up as?

nodes.speaker: Wesley
nodes.text: Not that it's any of your business, but I am going as Robo-Don, the wise-cracking robot mob boss of the beloved BotFather franchise.

nodes.speaker: Wesley
nodes.text: But for some reason, I can't get the pieces in this stupid costume to come together!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Maybe I can help... I'm pretty good at assembling things...

nodes.speaker: Wesley
nodes.text: Well... I guess it couldn't hurt...
$Scott and Brendan start frantically combing through all the props in the room...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: It's got to be here somewhere... I'm sure it's in here...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Hey. Hey, Brendan. Look at me. I'm dressed like a pirate. Yarrrr, matey! Shiver me timbers!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Not now, $Scott! This is not the time!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Arrrr! It always be a time for pirate mayhem, ya scurvy dog!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Seriously! Dinah's going to be here any minute! Stay focused!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I'll focus on making ya walk the plank, ya scabberous sea-slug!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I said, enough! Get out of my way!
Brendan dives across the room and shove $Scott aside... Just as the door swings open!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Brendan! I've been looking all over for you! What's going on? Why are you wrestling with a pirate?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh... Because... I was just getting... Your birthday present!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: What are you `talking` about?
nodes.text_bbcode: What are you [color=#3b78e2][i]talking[/i][/color] about?

nodes.text: Brendan fumbles desperately in the prop pile and pulls out...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: You got me a banana costume? That's... Pretty weird...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I mean, I'm open to new stuff, but... A banana costume?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Arrr, matey, the wench not be buying your ploy!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Okay, that does it. This is just too bizarre. I'm out of here.
Dinah turns and walks out.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: There is something `seriously` wrong with you, $Scott!
nodes.text_bbcode: There is something [color=#e23b3b][i]seriously[/i][/color] wrong with you, $Scott!

nodes.text: Brendan runs after her.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Arrrr, it be a hard life on the open seas.
$Scott drives over to the arcade.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: How's it going? It's a disaster, that's how it's going!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Today is Dinah's birthday, and I can't find the present I bought her! It's missing! It's stolen! It's gone!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I'm ruined, $Scott! Ruined!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Slow down. What's the present, and where did you leave it?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I got her this really nice antique locket... I found it at a vintage store, and it's totally her style...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: It might have fallen out of my pocket earlier today, but I checked in the Lost and Found, and it wasn't there! I know I lost it somewhere around here...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Well, we are in the theater, right? Maybe someone thought it was a prop and put it in the prop room.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You're totally right! That's got to be it!
Brendan and $Scott run to the prop room...
Which is a cluttered mess of everything from plastic swords to cardboard sets!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Dinah's gonna be here in ten minutes! We're never going to find it in time!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Keep calm, man! We've got this! Let's just search quickly!
$Scott heads to the theater...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Hey, Brendan! How's it going?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You know what? That's actually not a bad idea!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I told you I could help!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Ahem, ahem... Let's see... How should I start it...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: 'My maiden! My beauty! My eternal Queen!'

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: 'How I doth long to see your pale skin's sheen!'

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: 'Thy eyes gleam like the snow after winter's first thaw!'

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: 'Thy smile shines like scales upon a dragon's paw!'

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Dude, I'm going to cut you off right there. That is not working.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You compared her smile to a dragon's toenail!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Not much rhymes with 'thaw!'

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Maybe you ought to try something more hip... More modern... You know, something less medieval...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: 'Dinah, Dinah, you are so fine-a...'

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: 'You make me want to visit China?'

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Yeah, okay, let's just scratch the poem.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Well, great! Now I still don't know what to do, and I've wasted what little time I've got left!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Just leave me alone, okay? I need to think!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Sure, man... Sorry about that.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: A walk?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Sure! You know, a stroll through the woods, a walk along the beach... Artsy, sophisticated girls love that kind of thing!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You know... One of the first things we ever did together was go for a walk in the woods!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: There you go, man! It's perfect! I can just picture it now... The two of you walking through the forest... Holding hands...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You duck down behind a tree and pull out a picnic basket...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: We settle down together on a blanket...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: She leans over... She's smiling...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I gently kiss the side of her neck... Rest my face against her cheek...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: And whisper, so softly, 'I love you'...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Dude, is it just me, or did this conversation get really weird?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Yeah, we definitely crossed a line somewhere back there.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Well, it's a great idea, regardless! Thanks, $Scott! You really helped me out!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I guess you're not such a bad guy after all.
Nerd Approval Up!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Thanks, man! That really means a lot!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: No, no, no, that's not going to work... Shoot... I just don't know what to do...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Hey, uh, Brendan? You doing okay?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Huh? Oh, it's `you!` What are you doing here?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Huh? Oh, it's [color=#e23b3b][i]you![/i][/color] What are you doing here?!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Oh, uh, just being President... Trying to get to know the Student Body, checking out the theater, that sort of thing.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Look, I really don't have time for this right now. My girlfriend's birthday is this week, and I still haven't figured out what to do for her!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Well, did you get her a gift?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah, I bought her this great antique locket... But I don't `just` want to give her a gift! I want to do something that'll make her birthday feel special!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, I bought her this great antique locket... But I don't [color=#e23b3b][i]just[/i][/color] want to give her a gift! I want to do something that'll make her birthday feel special!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You know, I might actually be able to help you out. What's this girl like?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Well, she's funny and smart and pretty and cute and nice and sweet and cool!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Adorable as that was, it doesn't really help me... I mean more like, what are her interests? Her hobbies? Her passions?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh, right... Well, she's sort of a Goth... But she's into art and poetry and stuff... And she's into journalism, too... And she likes animals...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You're not making this easy, man. Let me just think about it for a second...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I've got it! You should...

options.label: Take her on a romantic walk.

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: So what are you doing here? I know you weren't looking to workshop my story...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Well, I was looking for you and your friends, actually. See, I'm throwing a party this Saturday... And I want you guys to be there!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: You want me... And my friends... To be at your party?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Sure!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Is this one of those things where it turns out to be a cruel trick and you spray me with pig's blood, and then I kill everyone with my latent psychic powers?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: What? No! Is that a thing?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Look, the truth is, I've realized lately that I haven't been much of a President. In fact, I've been pretty lousy... Especially when it comes to getting to know my constituency.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: This party is... Well, it's my attempt to fix that.

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: I guess I respect that... But I don't exactly speak for my friends.

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: If you want to get to know our group, you're going to want to hang out with Brendan or Wesley. Wesley usually heads to the arcade at lunch, and Brendan goes to the school theater during study hall.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Brendan and Wesley. Got it.

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: If you `really` want to spend time with us... We usually meet up after school for Quiz Bowl training. We could always use someone else to practice with.
nodes.text_bbcode: If you [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] want to spend time with us... We usually meet up after school for Quiz Bowl training. We could always use someone else to practice with.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Thanks, Ashley! You've been really helpful.

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Yeah, well... Good luck with your party and all that. And this time, try not to surprise Dexter!
$Scott heads over to the theater, where Brendan is pacing around furiously...

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I mean, sure, why not, right? Everyone loves a happy ending!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: But... But... But that's not how the real world works! In the real world, the girl doesn't get the guy!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: She pines and cries and writes mopey stories, and the guy doesn't even notice because he's too busy flirting with that dumb bimbo in his science class!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Are we still talking about your story? Because that's an uncomfortably specific detail...

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Forget about it, $Scott! It doesn't matter. A guy like you wouldn't understand what it's like to be unliked and unpopular!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Well... Maybe not a week ago... But right about now, I've got to say, I'm not exactly popular...

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: I guess you're technically correct... But it's not really the same thing.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I guess not.

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: You... You think that's how it should end? She `doesn't` get the guy? But that's such a downer!
nodes.text_bbcode: You... You think that's how it should end? She [color=#3b78e2][i]doesn't[/i][/color] get the guy? But that's such a downer!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Sure, but it's realistic, right? You don't always get what you want... But sometimes, you learn something important about yourself when you fail!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Maybe your character could realize that this guy isn't worth pining over and learn how to assert herself!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: You're... You're right! That `is` what I should do!
nodes.text_bbcode: You're... You're right! That [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] what I should do!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Uh, I mean... That's what the character in my story should do!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Thanks for the advice... Er... Story critique. You're actually a pretty insightful guy.
Nerd Approval Up!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Well, I try to be... Even if sometimes, I really blow it.
$Scott heads down to the library, where he spots a nerdy girl studying at a table...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Hey there. How's it going?

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Oh, uh, hi. I think I'm, um, not really supposed to talk to you...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I understand... You're probably pretty upset about the Winter Formal, huh?

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Actually, I didn't go. Dances are pretty lame, even if they have free food.

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: But Dexter is the leader of our group, and he's pretty furious with you... I mean, he's still breaking out in hives every couple of hours...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Yeah... I feel awful about that. Who knew someone could be allergic to fake snow?

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Oh, he's not allergic to fake snow... He just breaks out any time he's surprised by something! You should've seen what happened when Brendan bought him that Jack-in-the-Box!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Heh!
$Scott pulls up a chair and sits down next to Ashley.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Can I join you for a minute?

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Um... I guess it's okay... But make it quick!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: What're you working on?

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Well... I'm writing this short story for the lit club. It's about this sensitive, artsy girl who's secretly in love with her good friend... But he's not into her!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: The problem is, I can't decide how it ends...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Hmm... I think she should...
Inside the house, everyone settles into the party... And quickly starts judging the setup!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: No! Wait! You can't all leave! Not now!
$Scott runs out into the street.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Please! This is really, really important for me! I'll fix everything! I promise!
Everyone keeps walking. Someone throws a can at $Scott.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: But... But... But... It wasn't supposed to be like this...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Now that we've got that settled, I'd like to bring to the floor the impeachment of Student Body President $Scott, on grounds of gross mismanagement of school funds at the Winter Formal!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: How does the Council vote?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: And the nays have it! I'm not impeached! Booyah!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: What?! That's ridiculous! Are you joking? You're all `supporting` this idiot?!
nodes.text_bbcode: What?! That's ridiculous! Are you joking? You're all [color=#e23b3b][i]supporting[/i][/color] this idiot?!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Hey! $Scott's a pretty all-right guy, Justin...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: At least he's not some rulebook-quoting nerd like you!

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: As a nerd, I take offense to that! We might not be the coolest, but we're way cooler than Justin!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Looks like the crowd's spoken, Justin... And that means I'm still President!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: What? Two of you are supporting this idiot?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Afraid so, Justin... And that means `I'm` still President!
nodes.text_bbcode: Afraid so, Justin... And that means [color=#e23b3b][i]I'm[/i][/color] still President!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: But that's... That's ridiculous! How could any of you people support him?! Haven't you heard about all the programs he's planning to cut?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Maybe they're too smart to believe in rumors!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Maybe you're right... So it's time I showed them proof!
Justin reaches into his coat and pulls out a fake budget report with $Scott's forged signature!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: It's all here, folks! Selling off half the libary... Shutting down the Auto-Shop... Cancelling the athletics department...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I would like to officially change my vote to 'nay' on $Scott's impeachment!

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: I would like to officially change my vote to 'nay' on $Scott's impeachment!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I would like to officially change my vote to 'nay' on $Scott's impeachment!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: No! This isn't happening! I `know` I'd be the better President! I know it!
nodes.text_bbcode: No! This isn't happening! I [color=#e23b3b][i]know[/i][/color] I'd be the better President! I know it!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Argh! This doesn't prove anything! Just because you can convince a group of morons to support you...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Hey... You can insult me all you want... But the minute you insult my guests, that's a serious party foul.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: We're all just here to have a good time, so if you want to hang out, I might even look the other way... But you're going to have to drop the attitude, stat.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Heh, you know what? Who cares about being Student President? This is plenty of fun anyway!
That Monday, at Student Council...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Who votes to strip $Scott of his presidency, say 'aye'!

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: Aye!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Aye!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Nay!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: The Ayes have it! $Scott is stripped of his presidency! I am now President!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Pffft, who cares? Being President is for nerds and losers anyway!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Come on, Taylor! Let's go hit up the football game... We're getting lamer here by the minute!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Sure!
$Scott walks by, shoving Justin aside!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Out of my way, nerd!
Well, there certainly are worse things than being popular... But don't you think $Scott could've done better?
Winning over the `whole` school, and maybe even getting a girl... Now there's an ending!
nodes.text_bbcode: Winning over the [b]whole[/b] school, and maybe even getting a girl... Now there's an ending!

nodes.text: Try again! We know you can throw the best party ever... For all the cliques!
And so, the party goes on...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Oh, you think you could beat me at pool? I'm a born hustler, baby!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Yeah? Let's see you put your money where your mouth is!

nodes.text: No, no, no, that's all wrong! You can't soup up the outside of your car until you've improved your engine!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: But I love flame decals and hate manual labor!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Heh, you know what? Who cares about being Student President? This is plenty of fun anyway! Maybe I should've hung out with the rebels all along!

nodes.speaker: Justin

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Aye!

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: Aye!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Nay!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: The Ayes have it! $Scott is stripped of his presidency! I am now President!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Pffft, who cares? Being President is for preppy losers and lame nerds! I'm a rebel now! All right!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You want to bounce, Spike? I'd be totally game to hit up the skate park!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Word, dude! Let's do it!
$Scott walks by, shoving Justin aside!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Have fun with your Stupid Council, dork. I've got better things to do!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Come on, man, pass the WeeBox 360 Controller! It's my turn to play 'Space Marine: Vendetta'!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: No way! I called next!
And on...

nodes.text: Look. At. Me. I. Am. A. Dancing. Robot. Whirrrr... Beeeeep... Bzzzzztttt...

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: It's... Uncanny!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Heh, you know what? Who cares about being Student President? This is plenty of fun anyway! Maybe I should've hung out with the nerds all along!
That Monday, at Student Council...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You want to bounce, Dexter? There's some 'Call of Honor: Duty Valor Brothers' calling our name!

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: Heck yeah! Let's go kill some dwarven Nazis from space!
$Scott walks by, shoving Justin aside!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Have fun with your Stupid Council. I'll be laughing when I'm in a Viney League school!
Well, there certainly are worse things than being well-liked by the nerds... But don't you think $Scott could've done better?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: How? You can't have a party without any guests, Angie! How are we going to have a great time? How?!
Angie leans forward and passionately kisses $Scott!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I have wanted to do that for so, so long.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Well, I... I mean... That is to say... I mean... I...
$Scott leans forward and kisses Angie back!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Why use words where a kiss will suffice?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Things will be okay, $Scott. I realize that now. We've got each other, and that's all I care about.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Is that... Is that what you want too?
$Scott holds Angie's hands.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I'm not going to lie, I still wish the party had gone well tonight...

nodes.text: But you're right. There are way more important things than that... Things I've overlooked for way too long.

nodes.text: Now, come on, silly! Tonight is what we make it!

nodes.text: That's great news! I've been working really hard on preparing the invitations! Look!
Angie opens her backpack and shows you dozens and dozens of meticulously hand-written invitations!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Whoa! You seriously made all of these? Angie, you didn't have to...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I wanted to, $Scott. I want you to be President... And I want this party to be a huge hit!
$Scott reaches into the bag to look at the invitations...

nodes.text: Oh geez! These things aren't cool at all! They're covered in pink lace and hearts and sparkles!

nodes.text: Is that a kitten sticker? It totally is! I can't invite people to my party with a kitten sticker!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Well? What do you think? Do you like them?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Um... Well... They're...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: That's about what I expected. Thanks, Angie.
