nodes.text: Grr... This has `got` to be Justin's work! He's spreading lies to turn the school against me!
nodes.text_bbcode: Grr... This has [color=#e23b3b][i]got[/i][/color] to be Justin's work! He's spreading lies to turn the school against me!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Well, at least his lies are easy to disprove, right? Just file your plan for next year's student budget, and everyone will know the truth!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Well... Uh... Actually... I haven't exactly written it yet...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: What? Oh, $Scott, you were supposed to turn it in last week...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I know, but I've been sort of preoccupied with all this party stuff!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Whatever. I'm sure if I get people to like me, they'll see right through his stupid lies, right?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Well, speaking of which... Do you want to hear how you're doing with the cliques?
The next day, before school starts...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Hey, $Scott! How's it going?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I'm doing all right...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Listen, I was just wondering... How're you doing on getting supplies?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Well... Um... Not great to be honest...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: $Scott, you really can't forget about it! Not after what happened at Winter Formal!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I know, I know... I'll make sure to get stuff ready...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Anyway... Do you want to hear how you're doing with the cliques?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I think I'm doing pretty well!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Great! Keep it up... But don't forget you'll need people to show up if you want them to appreciate your hard work!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Speaking of which... Do you want to hear how you're doing with the cliques?
The next day, before school starts...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Hey there, $Scott. You won't believe the rumors flying about you today!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Oh?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Apparently, you're planning on cutting all funding to the cheerleading team, and you also plan to cut the cafeteria budget so all they can serve is Sloppy Toes!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: What are Sloppy Toes?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: They're third-rate Sloppy Joes. They're disgusting. The point is, you could put all these rumors to rest if you just wrote up the year's budget!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Look, I really don't have time for that, okay? When this party is done, I'll get to it, I promise.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Fine, fine. Do you want to know how you're doing with the cliques?
Late that night...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Man, I just can't sleep! I'm so nervous about this party! Maybe I'll go browse the internet...
$Scott signs onto his computer... And finds an eCard in his mailbox!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Heh, it's from Angie. 'Good luck tomorrow, $Scott! Our party is going to be great!'

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: 'P.S. If I see a snow machine, you're on your own.'

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I'm really glad I've got Angie on my side. I don't know where I'd be without her! She's so organized and mature and responsible...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I wonder if I've been taking her for granted, making her do all the grunt-work, counting on her to be there when I mess up...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Maybe it's time I started taking some of that weight off her shoulders... Maybe it's time I started acting more like a President!
Later that day, $Scott is heading to class when...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Hey, this week's issue of the school newspaper is out! Let's see what the front page headline is!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: 'Anonymous Source Says School Prez Plans To Shut Down All Clubs, Sports, Water Fountains'!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: This Justin thing has gone way too far! I'm going to need to come up with a way to handle his rumors...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I guess I could always write up a real budget... But ugh, that's so much effort! I'm sure I can come up with a better solution...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: The nerds really like you!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: The preps like you a lot!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: And the rebels love you! They think you're great!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: And the rebels are pretty lukewarm about you.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: The preps think you're kind of okay...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Well, the nerds don't hate you... But they still don't really like you that much...
Saturday morning...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Well, it's time to set everything up...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Hi, $Scott!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Angie! I wasn't sure you were going to make it... I was worried your parents might've grounded you, after all...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Well, my parents weren't thrilled about that C... So I didn't tell them I was coming here! They think I'm in the library, studying!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I've never really lied to them before... But you know what? This is just too important!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Sneaking out, lying to your parents, going to a party... You're turning into a regular delinquent!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I know, right? Next thing you know, I'll be stealing cars and mugging old ladies!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I was going to say staying out all night and dating guys in leather jackets, but hey, that's cool too, I guess.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Maybe guys in leather jackets just aren't my type. Maybe I'm more into...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Ahem! Let's start setting up!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Yeah, man! I got way more sensitive! I wrote down my feelings in a journal and listened to 'Deathcrab for Booty' and everything!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: At one point, my eyes started leaking water for some reason, but my dad said it was okay so long as I didn't let it happen again!
